reading.title: Text 4
reading.passage: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Dia Mirza and Adrian Grenier have a message for you: It's easy to beat plastic. They're part of a bunch of celebrities starring in a new video for World Environment Day – encouraging you, the consumer, to swap out your single-use plastic staples like straws and cutlery to combat the plastics crisis. The key messages that have been put together for World Environment Day do include a call for governments to enact legislation to curb single-use plastics. But the overarching message is directed at individuals. My concern with leaving it up to the individual, however, is our limited sense of what needs to be achieved. On their own, taking our own bags to the grocery store or quitting plastic straws, for example, will accomplish little and require very little of us. They could even be detrimental, satisfying a need to have "done our bit" without ever progressing onto bigger, bolder, more effective actions – a kind of "moral licensing" that allays our concerns and stops us doing more and asking more of those in charge. While the conversation around our environment and our responsibility toward it remains centered on shopping bags and straws, we're ignoring the balance of power that implies that as "consumers" we must shop sustainably, rather than as "citizens" hold our governments and industries to account to push for real systemic change. It's important to acknowledge that the environment isn't everyone's priority – or even most people's. We shouldn't expect it to be. In her latest book, Why Good People Do Bad Environmental Things, Wellesley College professor Elizabeth R. DeSombre argues that the best way to collectively change the behavior of large numbers of people is for the change to be structural. This might mean implementing policy such as a plastic tax that adds a cost to environmentally problematic action, or banning single-use plastics altogether. India has just announced it will "eliminate all single-use plastic in the country by 2022." There are also incentive-based ways of making better environmental choices easier, such as ensuring recycling is at least as easy as trash disposal. DeSombre isn't saying people should stop caring about the environment. It's just that individual actions are too slow, she says, for that to be the only, or even primary, approach to changing widespread behavior. None of this is about writing off the individual. It's just about putting things into perspective. We don't have time to wait. We need progressive policies that shape collective action (and rein in polluting businesses), alongside engaged citizens pushing for change.

options: A) demand new laws on the use of plastics
B) urge consumers to cut the use of plastics
C) invite public opinion on the plastics crisis
D) disclose the causes of the plastics crisis
questions.explanation: 第 36 题是细节题，正确答案 B）urge consumers to cut the use of plastics 定位句在第 1 段：他们是为世界环境日拍摄新视频的一批明星之一——视频鼓励作为消费者的你换掉吸管、餐具等一次性塑料常用品，以抗击塑料危机。正确项与原文构成同义替换（encouraging you, the consumer, to swap out your single-use plastic staples like straws and cutlery ↔ urge consumers to cut the use of plastics）。其余三项中，A 项属张冠李戴、C 项属无中生有、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: The author is concerned that "moral licensing" may____.
options: A) mislead us into doing worthless things
B) prevent us from making further efforts
C) weaken our sense of accomplishment
D) suppress our desire for success
questions.explanation: 第 37 题是细节题，正确答案 B）prevent us from making further efforts 定位句在第 3 段：这些（小动作）甚至可能有害：满足了我们「做了一点贡献」的需要，却让我们再也不去追求更大、更勇敢、更有效的行动——这是一种「道德许可」效应，它平息了我们的担忧，让我们停下来不再多做、也不再多要求当权者。正确项与原文构成同义替换（stops us doing more and asking more of those in charge ↔ prevent us from making further efforts；without ever progressing onto bigger, bolder, more effective actions ↔ prevent us from making further efforts）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、C 项属与原文相反、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: By pointing out our identity "citizens", the author indicates that____.
options: A) our focus should be shifted to community welfare
B) our relationship with local industries is improving
C) we have been actively exercising our civil rights
D) we should press our government to lead the combat
questions.explanation: 第 38 题是推断题，正确答案 D）we should press our government to lead the combat 定位句在第 4 段：当关于环境和我们对它的责任的讨论仍停留在购物袋和吸管上时，我们忽视了背后的权力关系——这种关系暗示我们作为「消费者」要可持续地购物，而不是作为「公民」追究政府和企业的责任、推动真正的系统性变革。正确项与原文构成同义替换（hold our governments and industries to account to push for real systemic change ↔ press our government to lead the combat）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、B 项属与原文相反、C 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: DeSombre argues that the best way for a collective change should be____.
questions.explanation: 第 39 题是细节题，正确答案 D）a top-down process 定位句在第 5 段：Wellesley 学院的 Elizabeth R. DeSombre 教授在新书《为什么好人做坏环境的事》中主张：要在大群体范围内改变行为，最好的办法是让改变是「结构性」的。正确项与原文构成同义替换（the best way to collectively change the behavior of large numbers of people is for the change to be structural ↔ a top-down process；implementing policy such as a plastic tax that adds a cost to environmentally problematic action, or banning single-use plastics altogether ↔ a top-down process）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属与原文相反、C 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: The author concludes that individual efforts____.
questions.explanation: 第 40 题是主旨题，正确答案 C）are far from sufficient 该题需通观全文作答。正确项与原文构成同义替换（On their own, taking our own bags to the grocery store or quitting plastic straws, for example, will accomplish little and require very little of us ↔ are far from sufficient；individual actions are too slow, she says, for that to be the only, or even primary, approach to changing widespread behavior ↔ are far from sufficient；We don't have time to wait. We need progressive policies that shape collective action (and rein in polluting businesses), alongside engaged citizens pushing for change ↔ are far from sufficient）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属无中生有、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Dia Mirza and Adrian Grenier have a message for you: It's easy to beat plastic. They're part of a bunch of celebrities starring in a new video for World Environment Day – encouraging you, the consumer, to swap out your single-use plastic staples like straws and cutlery to combat the plastics crisis.
paragraphs.zh: Arnold Schwarzenegger、Dia Mirza和Adrian Grenier向你传递一个信息:战胜塑料很容易。他们是为世界环境日拍摄新视频的一群名人中的一部分,该视频鼓励你这样的消费者,用可替代品取代你的一次性塑料必需品,如吸管和餐具,以应对塑料危机。

paragraphs.en: The key messages that have been put together for World Environment Day do include a call for governments to enact legislation to curb single-use plastics. But the overarching message is directed at individuals.
paragraphs.zh: 为世界环境日整合的关键信息确实包括呼吁政府制定法律来遏制一次性塑料。但总体信息是针对个人的。

paragraphs.en: My concern with leaving it up to the individual, however, is our limited sense of what needs to be achieved. On their own, taking our own bags to the grocery store or quitting plastic straws, for example, will accomplish little and require very little of us. They could even be detrimental, satisfying a need to have "done our bit" without ever progressing onto bigger, bolder, more effective actions – a kind of "moral licensing" that allays our concerns and stops us doing more and asking more of those in charge.
paragraphs.zh: 然而,我对把这件事留给个人的担忧在于,我们对需要实现什么目标的认识有限。例如,仅靠我们自己带购物袋去杂货店或戒掉塑料吸管,将取得很少成就,也只需要我们付出很少。它们甚至可能是有害的,满足了一种'我们已经尽力'的需求,却从未进展到更大、更大胆、更有效的行动——一种'道德许可',它缓解了我们的担忧,阻止我们做更多事情和向掌权者要求更多。

paragraphs.en: While the conversation around our environment and our responsibility toward it remains centered on shopping bags and straws, we're ignoring the balance of power that implies that as "consumers" we must shop sustainably, rather than as "citizens" hold our governments and industries to account to push for real systemic change.
paragraphs.zh: 当围绕我们的环境和我们对环境的责任的讨论仍然集中在购物袋和吸管上时,我们忽略了权力平衡,这种平衡意味着作为'消费者',我们必须可持续地购物,而不是作为'公民'追究我们的政府和行业的责任,推动真正的系统性变革。

paragraphs.en: It's important to acknowledge that the environment isn't everyone's priority – or even most people's. We shouldn't expect it to be. In her latest book, Why Good People Do Bad Environmental Things, Wellesley College professor Elizabeth R. DeSombre argues that the best way to collectively change the behavior of large numbers of people is for the change to be structural.
paragraphs.zh: 重要的是要承认,环境并不是每个人的优先事项——甚至不是大多数人的优先事项。我们不应该期望它是。在她的最新著作《为什么好人做坏的环境事》中,Wellesley College教授Elizabeth R. DeSombre认为,集体改变大量人群行为的最佳方式是让改变成为结构性的。

paragraphs.en: This might mean implementing policy such as a plastic tax that adds a cost to environmentally problematic action, or banning single-use plastics altogether. India has just announced it will "eliminate all single-use plastic in the country by 2022." There are also incentive-based ways of making better environmental choices easier, such as ensuring recycling is at least as easy as trash disposal.
paragraphs.zh: 这可能意味着实施政策,如塑料税,为环境问题行为增加成本,或者完全禁止一次性塑料。印度刚刚宣布将'在2022年之前消除该国所有一次性塑料'。还有基于激励的方式使更好的环境选择变得更容易,例如确保回收至少与垃圾处理一样容易。

paragraphs.en: DeSombre isn't saying people should stop caring about the environment. It's just that individual actions are too slow, she says, for that to be the only, or even primary, approach to changing widespread behavior.
paragraphs.zh: DeSombre并不是说人们应该停止关心环境。她说,只是个人行动太慢了,不能成为改变广泛行为的唯一甚至主要方法。

paragraphs.en: None of this is about writing off the individual. It's just about putting things into perspective. We don't have time to wait. We need progressive policies that shape collective action (and rein in polluting businesses), alongside engaged citizens pushing for change.
paragraphs.zh: 所有这些都不是要否定个人。这只是关乎正确看待事物。我们没有时间等待。我们需要塑造集体行动(并约束污染企业)的进步政策,以及推动变革的积极公民。

cloze.passage: Weighing yourself regularly is a wonderful way to stay aware of any significant weight fluctuations. [1] , when done too often, this habit can sometimes hurt more than it [2] . As for me, weighing myself every day caused me to shift my focus from being generally healthy and physically active, to focusing [3] on the scale. That was bad for my overall fitness goals. I had gained weight in the form of muscle mass, but thinking only of [4] the number on the scale, I altered my training program. That conflicted with how I needed to train to [5] my goals. If my training intensity remains the same, but I'm constantly [15] and dropping weight, this is a [16] that I need to increase my daily caloric intake. blanks.explanation: 第 1 空正确答案 D）However。前句褒后句贬，构成明显语义反转。其余三项：A）Besides 表补充而非转折、B）Therefore 表因果方向反了、C）Otherwise 表假设条件下的相反结果，均可排除。
第 2 空正确答案 A）helps。本句 hurt 与空成反义对照。其余三项：B）cares 动作主体不对，且非 hurt 的反义、C）warns 义近"提醒"但与 hurt 不对照、D）reduces 缺宾语、且语义不对，均可排除。
第 3 空正确答案 B）solely。前文用 shift ... from ... to 暗示"由广转窄"。其余三项：A）initially 时间维度，错维度、C）occasionally 频率"偶尔"，与每日称重事实矛盾、D）formally 方式"正式地"，语义与场景无关，均可排除。
第 4 空正确答案 B）lowering。上句揭示"增肌反致体重上升"是动机背景。其余三项：A）recording 只"记"无须改训练，动机不足、C）explaining "解释数字"语义不通、D）accepting 若接受数字就不会改训练，与后果相反，均可排除。
第 5 空正确答案 D）reach。前句指出新训练与正确训练方式相冲突。其余三项：A）modify "修改目标"与练习目的不符、B）set "设定目标"在训练之前已完成、C）review "复审目标"与训练目的无关，均可排除。
第 6 空正确答案 B）depiction。accurate ___ of 努力与进展 = 准确反映/描绘。其余三项：A）definition "定义"对象是概念非过程、C）distribution "分布"对象不对、D）prediction "预测"指向未来，时态对不上，均可排除。
第 7 空正确答案 A）due to。前果后因——"改训练"是"体重变化"的原因。其余三项：B）regardless of "不管"否认因果，与语境相反、C）aside from "除……之外"语义跑偏、D）along with "伴随"表共现非因果，均可排除。
第 8 空正确答案 D）immediate。前句强调体重变化"慢"，本句应给出"快"的对照。其余三项：A）orderly "有序的"与时间维度不符、B）rigid "僵硬的"褒贬不符、C）precise "精确的"维度错，不与"慢"对照，均可排除。
第 9 空正确答案 C）reasons。第2、3段全是"为什么不该每日称重"的原因。其余三项：A）claims "主张"指尚未证实的说法、B）judgments "判断"指评价行为、D）methods "方法"指代对象与前文不符，均可排除。
第 10 空正确答案 A）instead。stopped ... switched ... 即"换做新做法"对比。其余三项：B）though "不过"用作让步，无对照对象、C）again "又一次"与首次更改不符、D）indeed "确实"用作强调，与替代关系不符，均可排除。
第 11 空正确答案 A）track。Since weight loss is not my goal 是因。其余三项：B）overlook "忽视"则不需"less important"修饰、C）conceal "隐瞒"对象错位、D）report "汇报"需有接收方，均可排除。
第 12 空正确答案 D）account for。并列动词 observe 锚定"观察—理解"语义链。其余三项：A）depend on "依赖"与 observe 不形成递进、B）approve of "赞成"语义反向、C）hold onto "抓住不放"对象不对，均可排除。
第 13 空正确答案 B）adjust。上句"解释体重变化"指向"是否要改训练"。其余三项：A）share "分享"无逻辑必要、C）confirm "确认"语义偏弱、D）prepare "准备"指向新计划，均可排除。
第 14 空正确答案 A）results。"用 weigh-in ___ 获取营养信息"暗示"结果/数据"。其余三项：B）features "特征"对象错、C）rules "规则"无法用于获取信息、D）tests "测试"与 weigh-in 重复，均可排除。
第 15 空正确答案 C）hungry。下句"需要增加每日热量摄入"反推原因为"缺热量"。其余三项：A）bored "无聊"与热量摄入无关、B）anxious "焦虑"无法由"缺热量"线性解释、D）sick "生病"不能用"加热量"解决，均可排除。
第 16 空正确答案 D）sign。前文给"饿+掉体重"，本句给"需要加热量"。其余三项：A）principle "原则"对象错、B）secret "秘诀"语境不对、C）belief "信念"对象不对，均可排除。
第 17 空正确答案 C）decision。前文"For these reasons, I stopped"表明是作者自己拿的主意。其余三项：A）request "请求"动作发出者错、B）necessity "必要性"过于客观、与亲历语境不符、D）wish "愿望"未必已落实，均可排除。
第 18 空正确答案 A）disappointing。burden 是负面词，weigh-in 又与"看见数字不如意"挂钩。其余三项：B）surprising "令人惊讶"偏中性、与 burden 不搭、C）restricting "限制性的"对象错、D）consuming "消耗的"语义偏"时间/精力消耗"，均可排除。
第 19 空正确答案 D）because。主句报喜"取得更大成功"，从句给原因"按目标训练"。其余三项：A）if "如果"表假设，与已实现的成功矛盾、B）unless "除非"逻辑反向、C）until "直到"是时间，非因果，均可排除。
第 20 空正确答案 A）obsessing。对照对象 turn focus to ... 暗示"原本注意力被秤夺走"。其余三项：B）dominating "支配"主宾关系反了、C）puzzling "困惑"语义不对、D）triumphing "凯旋、胜过"语义反向，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: Weighing yourself regularly is a wonderful way to stay aware of any significant weight fluctuations. [1] , when done too often, this habit can sometimes hurt more than it [2] .
paragraphs.zh: 定期称体重是了解体重显著波动的好方法。然而,当称重过于频繁时,这一习惯有时弊大于利。

paragraphs.en: As for me, weighing myself every day caused me to shift my focus from being generally healthy and physically active, to focusing [3] on the scale. That was bad for my overall fitness goals. I had gained weight in the form of muscle mass, but thinking only of [4] the number on the scale, I altered my training program. That conflicted with how I needed to train to [5] my goals.
paragraphs.zh: 就我而言,每天称体重使我的注意力从保持总体健康和身体活跃转移到只关注体重秤上的数字。这对我的整体健身目标不利。我以肌肉质量的形式增加了体重,但由于只想着降低体重秤上的数字,我改变了训练计划。这与我为实现目标所需的训练方式相冲突。

paragraphs.en: I also found that weighing myself daily did not provide an accurate [6] of the hard work and progress I was making in the gym. It takes about three weeks to a month to notice significant changes in your weight [7] altering your training program. The most [8] changes will be observed in skill level, strength and inches lost.
paragraphs.zh: 我还发现每天称体重无法准确反映我在健身房付出的努力和取得的进步。由于改变训练计划而导致体重发生显著变化大约需要三周到一个月的时间。最直接的变化将体现在技能水平、力量和减少的英寸数上。

paragraphs.en: For these [9] , I stopped weighing myself every day and switched to a bimonthly weighing schedule [10] . Since weight loss is not my goal, it is less important for me to [11] my weight each week. Weighing every other week allows me to observe and [12] any significant weight changes. That tells me whether I need to [13] my training program.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这些原因,我停止了每天称体重,改为每两周称一次体重。由于减重不是我的目标,每周跟踪体重对我来说不那么重要。每两周称一次体重让我能够观察和记录任何显著的体重变化。这告诉我是否需要调整训练计划。

paragraphs.en: I use my bimonthly weigh-in [14] to get information about my nutrition as well. If my training intensity remains the same, but I'm constantly [15] and dropping weight, this is a [16] that I need to increase my daily caloric intake.
paragraphs.zh: 我还利用每两周一次的称重结果来获取关于营养的信息。如果我的训练强度保持不变,但我经常感到饥饿并且体重下降,这表明我需要增加每日热量摄入。

paragraphs.en: The [17] to stop weighing myself every day has done wonders for my overall health, fitness and well-being. I'm experiencing increased zeal for working out since I no longer carry the burden of a [18] morning weigh-in. I've also experienced greater success in achieving my specific fitness goals, [19] I'm training according to those goals, not the numbers on a scale.
paragraphs.zh: 停止每天称体重的决定对我的整体健康、健身和幸福感产生了奇妙的效果。由于不再承受令人失望的晨间称重的负担,我对锻炼的热情增加了。我在实现具体健身目标方面也取得了更大的成功,因为我是根据这些目标进行训练,而不是根据体重秤上的数字。

paragraphs.en: Rather than [20] over the scale, turn your focus to how you look, feel, how your clothes fit and your overall energy level.
paragraphs.zh: 与其纠结于体重秤,不如将注意力转向你的外表、感觉、衣服的合身度以及整体精力水平。

reading.title: Text 1
reading.passage: A group of Labour MPs, among them Yvette Cooper, are bringing in the new year with a call to institute a UK "town of culture" award. The proposal is that it should sit alongside the existing city of culture title, which was held by Hull in 2017, and has been awarded to Coventry for 2021. Cooper and her colleagues argue that the success of the crown for Hull, where it brought in £220m of investment and an avalanche of arts, ought not to be confined to cities. Britain's towns, it is true, are not prevented from applying, but they generally lack the resources to put together a bid to beat their bigger competitors. A town of culture award could, it is argued, become an annual event, attracting funding and creating jobs. Some might see the proposal as a booby prize for the fact that Britain is no longer able to apply for the much more prestigious title of European capital of culture, a sought-after award bagged by Glasgow in 1990 and Liverpool in 2008. A cynic might speculate that the UK is on the verge of disappearing into an endless fever of self-celebration in its desperation to reinvent itself for the post-Brexit world: after town of culture, who knows what will follow—village of culture? Suburb of culture? Hamlet of culture? It is also wise to recall that such titles are not a cure-all. A badly run "year of culture" washes in and washes out of a place like the tide, bringing prominence for a spell but leaving no lasting benefits to the community. The really successful holders of such titles are those that do a great deal more than fill hotel bedrooms and bring in high-profile arts events and good press for a year. They transform the aspirations of the people who live there; they nudge the self-image of the city into a bolder and more optimistic light. It is hard to get right, and requires a remarkable degree of vision, as well as cooperation between city authorities, the private sector, community groups and cultural organisations. But it can be done: Glasgow's year as European capital of culture can certainly be seen as one of a complex series of factors that have turned the city into the powerhouse of art, music and theatre that it remains today. A "town of culture" could be not just about the arts but about honouring a town's peculiarities—helping sustain its high street, supporting local facilities and above all celebrating its people. Jeremy Wright, the culture secretary, should welcome this positive, hope-filled proposal, and turn it into action.

questions.stem: Cooper and her colleagues argue that a "town of culture" award could____
options: A) consolidate the town-city ties in Britain.
B) promote cooperation among Britain's towns.
C) increase the economic strength of Britain's towns.
D) focus Britain's limited resources on cultural events.
questions.explanation: 第 21 题是细节题，正确答案 C）increase the economic strength of Britain's towns. 定位句在第 1 段：有人主张，town of culture 奖项可以成为年度活动，吸引资金、创造就业。正确项与原文构成同义替换（attracting funding and creating jobs ↔ increase the economic strength of Britain's towns）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属张冠李戴、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 2, the proposal might be regarded by some as____
questions.explanation: 第 22 题是细节题，正确答案 B）a self-deceiving attempt. 定位句在第 2 段：一位愤世嫉俗者也许会推测：英国正濒临陷入无休止的自我庆祝狂热，急切地想为后脱欧时代重塑自身——继 town of culture 之后，谁知道接下来会是什么？village of culture？suburb of culture？hamlet of culture？正确项与原文构成同义替换（in its desperation to reinvent itself for the post-Brexit world ↔ a self-deceiving attempt；Some might see the proposal as a booby prize ↔ a self-deceiving attempt）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、C 项属与原文相反、D 项属张冠李戴，均可排除。

questions.stem: The author suggests that a title holder is successful only if it____
options: A) endeavours to maintain its image.
B) meets the aspiration of its people.
C) brings its local arts to prominence.
D) commits to its long-term growth.
questions.explanation: 第 23 题是细节题，正确答案 D）commits to its long-term growth. 定位句在第 3 段：真正成功的称号持有者，是那些做的远远不止于把酒店住满、办一年高调艺术活动、博取一年好评的城市。它们改变当地居民的志向，把城市的自我形象推向更大胆、更乐观的境界。正确项与原文构成同义替换（do a great deal more than fill hotel bedrooms and bring in high-profile arts events and good press for a year ↔ commits to its long-term growth；transform the aspirations of the people who live there ↔ commits to its long-term growth）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属偷换概念、C 项属以偏概全，均可排除。

questions.stem: Glasgow is mentioned in Paragraph 3 to present____
questions.explanation: 第 24 题是例证目的题，正确答案 B）a supporting example. 定位句在第 3 段：但这是可以做到的：Glasgow 当年作为欧洲文化之都的那一年，完全可视为一系列复杂因素之一，正是这些因素把它变成了今天依然如是的艺术、音乐、戏剧重镇。正确项与原文构成同义替换（But it can be done: Glasgow's year as European capital of culture can certainly be seen as one of a complex series of factors that have turned the city into the powerhouse of art, music and theatre that it remains today ↔ a supporting example）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、C 项属偷换概念、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: What is the author's attitude towards the proposal?
questions.explanation: 第 25 题是态度题，正确答案 C）Favourable. 该题需通观全文作答。正确项与原文构成同义替换（should welcome this positive, hope-filled proposal, and turn it into action ↔ Favourable；But it can be done ↔ Favourable）。其余三项中，A 项属张冠李戴、B 项属以偏概全、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: A group of Labour MPs, among them Yvette Cooper, are bringing in the new year with a call to institute a UK "town of culture" award. The proposal is that it should sit alongside the existing city of culture title, which was held by Hull in 2017, and has been awarded to Coventry for 2021. Cooper and her colleagues argue that the success of the crown for Hull, where it brought in £220m of investment and an avalanche of arts, ought not to be confined to cities. Britain's towns, it is true, are not prevented from applying, but they generally lack the resources to put together a bid to beat their bigger competitors. A town of culture award could, it is argued, become an annual event, attracting funding and creating jobs.
paragraphs.zh: 一群工党议员，其中包括伊薇特·库珀，在新年之际呼吁设立英国"文化城镇"奖。该提案建议它应与现有的"文化之城"称号并列，后者在2017年由赫尔持有，并已授予考文垂2021年的称号。库珀及其同事认为,赫尔获得这一桂冠取得的成功——为该地带来了2.2亿英镑的投资和大量艺术活动——不应仅限于城市。诚然,英国的城镇并未被禁止申请,但它们通常缺乏资源来组织申请以击败更大的竞争对手。有人认为,"文化城镇"奖可以成为一项年度活动,吸引资金并创造就业机会。

paragraphs.en: Some might see the proposal as a booby prize for the fact that Britain is no longer able to apply for the much more prestigious title of European capital of culture, a sought-after award bagged by Glasgow in 1990 and Liverpool in 2008. A cynic might speculate that the UK is on the verge of disappearing into an endless fever of self-celebration in its desperation to reinvent itself for the post-Brexit world: after town of culture, who knows what will follow—village of culture? Suburb of culture? Hamlet of culture?
paragraphs.zh: 有些人可能会将这一提案视为英国不再能够申请更具声望的"欧洲文化之都"称号的安慰奖,这一备受追捧的奖项曾在1990年由格拉斯哥获得,2008年由利物浦获得。愤世嫉俗者可能会推测,英国正处于陷入无休止的自我庆祝狂热的边缘,迫切希望为后脱欧时代重塑自己:在"文化城镇"之后,谁知道接下来会是什么——"文化村庄"?"文化郊区"?"文化小村"?

paragraphs.en: It is also wise to recall that such titles are not a cure-all. A badly run "year of culture" washes in and washes out of a place like the tide, bringing prominence for a spell but leaving no lasting benefits to the community. The really successful holders of such titles are those that do a great deal more than fill hotel bedrooms and bring in high-profile arts events and good press for a year. They transform the aspirations of the people who live there; they nudge the self-image of the city into a bolder and more optimistic light. It is hard to get right, and requires a remarkable degree of vision, as well as cooperation between city authorities, the private sector, community groups and cultural organisations. But it can be done: Glasgow's year as European capital of culture can certainly be seen as one of a complex series of factors that have turned the city into the powerhouse of art, music and theatre that it remains today.
paragraphs.zh: 明智的做法还在于记住,此类称号并非万能良药。运作不善的"文化年"会像潮水一样涌入又退出一个地方,带来一时的知名度,但不会给社区留下持久的益处。此类称号真正成功的持有者,远不止填满酒店客房、引入高规格艺术活动和一年的良好媒体报道。它们改变了当地居民的抱负;它们将城市的自我形象推向更大胆、更乐观的方向。这很难做到,需要非凡的远见,以及城市当局、私营部门、社区团体和文化组织之间的合作。但这是可以做到的:格拉斯哥作为欧洲文化之都的那一年,无疑可以被视为一系列复杂因素之一,这些因素将这座城市转变为今天仍然保持的艺术、音乐和戏剧重镇。

paragraphs.en: A "town of culture" could be not just about the arts but about honouring a town's peculiarities—helping sustain its high street, supporting local facilities and above all celebrating its people. Jeremy Wright, the culture secretary, should welcome this positive, hope-filled proposal, and turn it into action.
paragraphs.zh: "文化城镇"不仅可以关乎艺术,还可以关乎尊重一个城镇的特色——帮助维持其商业街,支持当地设施,最重要的是颂扬其居民。文化大臣杰里米·赖特应该欢迎这个积极、充满希望的提案,并将其付诸行动。

reading.title: Text 2
reading.passage: Scientific publishing has long been a licence to print money. Scientists need journals in which to publish their research, so they will supply the articles without monetary reward. Other scientists perform the specialised work of peer review also for free, because it is a central element in the acquisition of status and the production of scientific knowledge. With the content of papers secured for free, the publisher needs only find a market for its journal. Until this century, university libraries were not very price sensitive. Scientific publishers routinely report profit margins approaching 40% on their operations at a time when the rest of the publishing industry is in an existential crisis. The Dutch giant Elsevier, which claims to publish 25% of the scientific papers produced in the world, made profits of more than £900m last year, while UK universities alone spent more than £210m in 2016 to enable researchers to access their own publicly funded research; both figures seem to rise unstoppably despite increasingly desperate efforts to change them. The most drastic, and thoroughly illegal, reaction has been the emergence of Sci-Hub, a kind of global photocopier for scientific papers, set up in 2012, which now claims to offer access to every paywalled article published since 2015. The success of Sci-Hub, which relies on researchers passing on copies they have themselves legally accessed, shows the legal ecosystem has lost legitimacy among its users and must be transformed so that it works for all participants. In Britain the move towards open access publishing has been driven by funding bodies. In some ways it has been very successful. More than half of all British scientific research is now published under open access terms: either freely available from the moment of publication, or paywalled for a year or more so that the publishers can make a profit before being placed on general release. Yet the new system has not yet worked out any cheaper for the universities. Publishers have responded to the demand that they make their product free to readers by charging their writers fees to cover the costs of preparing an article. These range from around £500 to £5,000, and apparently the work gets more expensive the more that publishers do it. A report last year pointed out that the costs both of subscriptions and of these "article preparation costs" had been steadily rising at a rate above inflation. In some ways the scientific publishing model resembles the economy of the social internet: labour is provided free in exchange for the hope of status, while huge profits are made by a few big firms who run the market places. In both cases, we need a rebalancing of power.

questions.stem: Scientific publishing is seen as "a licence to print money" partly because____
options: A) its funding has enjoyed a steady increase.
B) its marketing strategy has been successful.
C) its payment for peer review is reduced.
D) its content acquisition costs nothing.
questions.explanation: 第 26 题是细节题，正确答案 D）its content acquisition costs nothing. 定位句在第 1 段：科学家需要期刊来发表自己的研究，所以他们会无偿提供文章。正确项与原文构成同义替换（they will supply the articles without monetary reward ↔ its content acquisition costs nothing；Other scientists perform the specialised work of peer review also for free ↔ its content acquisition costs nothing）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属偷换概念、C 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: According to Paragraphs 2 and 3, scientific publishers Elsevier have____
options: A) thrived mainly on university libraries.
B) gone through an existential crisis.
questions.explanation: 第 27 题是细节题，正确答案 A）thrived mainly on university libraries. 定位句在第 3 段：号称发表了全球 25% 科研论文的荷兰巨头爱思唯尔去年获利超过 9 亿英镑，而仅英国的大学就在 2016 年花了 2.1 亿多英镑，让研究者去获取他们自己用公共资金完成的研究。正确项与原文构成同义替换（UK universities alone spent more than £210m in 2016 to enable researchers to access their own publicly funded research ↔ thrived mainly on university libraries；Until this century, university libraries were not very price sensitive ↔ thrived mainly on university libraries）。其余三项中，B 项属张冠李戴、C 项属过度推断、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: How does the author feel about the success of Sci-Hub?
questions.explanation: 第 28 题是态度题，正确答案 C）Concerned. 定位句在第 4 段：Sci-Hub 的成功——它依赖研究者把自己合法获取的副本传出去——表明现行的合法生态已经在用户中失去了合法性，必须被改造以服务所有参与方。正确项与原文构成同义替换（the legal ecosystem has lost legitimacy among its users and must be transformed ↔ Concerned；The most drastic, and thoroughly illegal, reaction has been the emergence of Sci-Hub ↔ Concerned）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属无中生有、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: It can be learned from Paragraphs 5 and 6 that open access terms____
options: A) allow publishers some room to make money.
B) render publishing much easier for scientists.
C) reduce the cost of publication substantially.
D) free universities from financial burdens.
questions.explanation: 第 29 题是推断题，正确答案 A）allow publishers some room to make money. 定位句在第 5 段：如今英国超过一半的科研成果是按开放获取条款发表的：要么从发表那一刻起就免费可读，要么先用付费墙挡上一年以上、让出版商先赚一笔，然后再普遍开放。正确项与原文构成同义替换（paywalled for a year or more so that the publishers can make a profit before being placed on general release ↔ allow publishers some room to make money；Publishers have responded to the demand that they make their product free to readers by charging their writers fees to cover the costs of preparing an article ↔ allow publishers some room to make money）。其余三项中，B 项属无中生有、C 项属与原文相反、D 项属过度推断，均可排除。

questions.stem: Which of the following characterizes the scientific publishing model?
options: D) The few feed on the many.
questions.explanation: 第 30 题是主旨题，正确答案 D）The few feed on the many. 该题需通观全文作答。正确项与原文构成同义替换（labour is provided free in exchange for the hope of status, while huge profits are made by a few big firms who run the market places ↔ The few feed on the many；they will supply the articles without monetary reward ↔ The few feed on the many；made profits of more than £900m last year ↔ The few feed on the many）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属与原文相反、C 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: Scientific publishing has long been a licence to print money. Scientists need journals in which to publish their research, so they will supply the articles without monetary reward. Other scientists perform the specialised work of peer review also for free, because it is a central element in the acquisition of status and the production of scientific knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 科学出版长期以来一直是印钞许可证。科学家需要期刊来发表他们的研究，因此他们会无偿提供文章。其他科学家也免费从事同行评审这一专业工作,因为它是获取地位和产出科学知识的核心要素。

paragraphs.en: With the content of papers secured for free, the publisher needs only find a market for its journal. Until this century, university libraries were not very price sensitive. Scientific publishers routinely report profit margins approaching 40% on their operations at a time when the rest of the publishing industry is in an existential crisis.
paragraphs.zh: 在免费获得论文内容的情况下,出版商只需为其期刊找到市场。直到本世纪,大学图书馆对价格并不十分敏感。科学出版商通常报告其业务利润率接近40%,而此时出版业的其他领域正处于生存危机之中。

paragraphs.en: The Dutch giant Elsevier, which claims to publish 25% of the scientific papers produced in the world, made profits of more than £900m last year, while UK universities alone spent more than £210m in 2016 to enable researchers to access their own publicly funded research; both figures seem to rise unstoppably despite increasingly desperate efforts to change them.
paragraphs.zh: 荷兰巨头Elsevier声称出版世界上25%的科学论文,去年盈利超过9亿英镑,而仅英国大学在2016年就花费了超过2.1亿英镑,以使研究人员能够获取他们自己由公共资金资助的研究成果;尽管人们越来越不顾一切地努力改变这些数字,但两个数字似乎都在不可阻挡地上升。

paragraphs.en: The most drastic, and thoroughly illegal, reaction has been the emergence of Sci-Hub, a kind of global photocopier for scientific papers, set up in 2012, which now claims to offer access to every paywalled article published since 2015. The success of Sci-Hub, which relies on researchers passing on copies they have themselves legally accessed, shows the legal ecosystem has lost legitimacy among its users and must be transformed so that it works for all participants.
paragraphs.zh: 最激进且完全非法的反应是Sci-Hub的出现,这是一个科学论文的全球复印机,成立于2012年,现在声称可以访问自2015年以来发表的每一篇付费墙论文。Sci-Hub的成功依赖于研究人员传递他们自己合法获取的副本,这表明法律生态系统已经在其用户中失去了合法性,必须进行转型,使其为所有参与者服务。

paragraphs.en: In Britain the move towards open access publishing has been driven by funding bodies. In some ways it has been very successful. More than half of all British scientific research is now published under open access terms: either freely available from the moment of publication, or paywalled for a year or more so that the publishers can make a profit before being placed on general release.
paragraphs.zh: 在英国,向开放获取出版的转变一直由资助机构推动。在某些方面它非常成功。现在超过一半的英国科学研究是在开放获取条件下发表的:要么从发表之时起即可免费获取,要么设置一年或更长时间的付费墙,以便出版商在向公众发布前获利。

paragraphs.en: Yet the new system has not yet worked out any cheaper for the universities. Publishers have responded to the demand that they make their product free to readers by charging their writers fees to cover the costs of preparing an article. These range from around £500 to £5,000, and apparently the work gets more expensive the more that publishers do it. A report last year pointed out that the costs both of subscriptions and of these "article preparation costs" had been steadily rising at a rate above inflation. In some ways the scientific publishing model resembles the economy of the social internet: labour is provided free in exchange for the hope of status, while huge profits are made by a few big firms who run the market places. In both cases, we need a rebalancing of power.
paragraphs.zh: 然而,新系统对大学来说尚未变得更便宜。出版商对让读者免费获取其产品的要求的回应是,向作者收取费用以支付准备文章的成本。这些费用从大约500英镑到5000英镑不等,而且显然出版商做得越多,工作就变得越昂贵。去年的一份报告指出,订阅费用和这些"文章准备费用"的成本一直在以高于通货膨胀的速度稳步上升。在某些方面,科学出版模式类似于社交互联网的经济:劳动力免费提供以换取地位的希望,而少数几家运营市场的大公司却赚取了巨额利润。在这两种情况下,我们都需要权力的再平衡。

reading.title: Text 3
reading.passage: Progressives often support diversity mandates as a path to equality and a way to level the playing field. But all too often such policies are an insincere form of virtue-signaling that benefits only the most privileged and does little to help average people. A pair of bills sponsored by Massachusetts state Senator Jason Lewis and House Speaker Pro Tempore Patricia Haddad, to ensure "gender parity" on boards and commissions, provides a case in point. Haddad and Lewis are concerned that more than half the state-government boards are less than 40 percent female. In order to ensure that elite women have more such opportunities, they have proposed imposing government quotas. If the bills become law, state boards and commissions will be required to set aside 50 percent of board seats for women by 2022. The bills are similar to a measure recently adopted in California, which last year became the first state to require gender quotas for private companies. In signing the measure, California Governor Jerry Brown admitted that the law, which expressly classifies people on the basis of sex, is probably unconstitutional. The US Supreme Court frowns on sex-based classifications unless they are designed to address an "important" policy interest. Because the California law applies to all boards, even where there is no history of prior discrimination, courts are likely to rule that the law violates the constitutional guarantee of "equal protection". But are such government mandates even necessary? Female participation on corporate boards may not currently mirror the percentage of women in the general population, but so what? The number of women on corporate boards has been steadily increasing without government interference. According to a study by Catalyst, between 2010 and 2015 the share of women on the boards of global corporations increased by 54 percent. Requiring companies to make gender the primary qualification for board membership will inevitably lead to less experienced private sector boards. That is exactly what happened when Norway adopted a nationwide corporate gender quota. Writing in The New Republic, Alice Lee notes that increasing the number of opportunities for board membership without increasing the pool of qualified women to serve on such boards has led to a "golden skirt" phenomenon, where the same elite women scoop up multiple seats on a variety of boards. Next time somebody pushes corporate quotas as a way to promote gender equity, remember that such policies are largely self-serving measures that make their sponsors feel good but do little to help average women.

questions.stem: The author believes that the bills sponsored by Lewis and Haddad will____
options: A) help little to reduce gender bias.
B) pose a threat to the state government.
C) raise women's position in politics.
questions.explanation: 第 31 题是细节题，正确答案 A）help little to reduce gender bias. 定位句在第 1 段：但这类政策往往只是不真诚的姿态作秀，只惠及最有特权的人群，对普通人几乎没有任何帮助。正确项与原文构成同义替换（does little to help average people ↔ help little to reduce gender bias）。其余三项中，B 项属无中生有、C 项属偷换概念、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: Which of the following is true of the California measure?
options: A) It has irritated private business owners.
B) It is welcomed by the Supreme Court.
C) It may go against the Constitution.
D) It will settle the prior controversies.
questions.explanation: 第 32 题是细节题，正确答案 C）It may go against the Constitution. 定位句在第 4 段：在签署该法案时，加州州长杰里·布朗承认，这部明确按性别对人进行分类的法律可能违宪。正确项与原文构成同义替换（is probably unconstitutional ↔ It may go against the Constitution；the law violates the constitutional guarantee of "equal protection" ↔ It may go against the Constitution）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属与原文相反、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: The author mentions the study by Catalyst to illustrate____
options: A) the harm from arbitrary board decision.
B) the importance of constitutional guarantees.
C) the pressure on women in global corporations.
D) the needlessness of government interventions.
questions.explanation: 第 33 题是例证目的题，正确答案 D）the needlessness of government interventions. 定位句在第 7 段：在没有政府干预的情况下，企业董事会中的女性人数一直在稳步上升。根据 Catalyst 的一项研究，2010 至 2015 年间，全球公司董事会中的女性比例增长了 54%。正确项与原文构成同义替换（without government interference ↔ the needlessness of government interventions；But are such government mandates even necessary? ↔ the needlessness of government interventions）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属答非所问、C 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: Norway's adoption of a nationwide corporate gender quota has led to____
options: A) the underestimation of elite women's role.
B) the objection to female participation on boards.
C) the entry of unqualified candidates into the board.
D) the growing tension between labor and management.
questions.explanation: 第 34 题是细节题，正确答案 C）the entry of unqualified candidates into the board. 定位句在第 8 段：要求公司把性别当成进入董事会的首要资格，必然导致私营董事会经验下降。挪威在全国范围内推行公司性别配额时，发生的正是这种情况。正确项与原文构成同义替换（will inevitably lead to less experienced private sector boards ↔ the entry of unqualified candidates into the board；without increasing the pool of qualified women to serve on such boards ↔ the entry of unqualified candidates into the board）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属偷换概念、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: Which of the following can be inferred from the text?
options: A) Women's need in employment should be considered.
B) Feasibility should be a prime concern in policymaking.
C) Everyone should try hard to promote social justice.
D) Major social issues should be the focus of legislation.
questions.explanation: 第 35 题是推断题，正确答案 B）Feasibility should be a prime concern in policymaking. 该题需通观全文作答。正确项与原文构成同义替换（does little to help average people ↔ Feasibility should be a prime concern in policymaking；But are such government mandates even necessary? ↔ Feasibility should be a prime concern in policymaking；will inevitably lead to less experienced private sector boards ↔ Feasibility should be a prime concern in policymaking）。其余三项中，A 项属答非所问、C 项属过度推断、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: Progressives often support diversity mandates as a path to equality and a way to level the playing field. But all too often such policies are an insincere form of virtue-signaling that benefits only the most privileged and does little to help average people.
paragraphs.zh: 进步人士常常支持多元化强制措施,将其视为通往平等的途径和创造公平竞争环境的方式。但这类政策往往是一种不真诚的美德信号形式,只让最有特权的人受益,对普通人却帮助甚微。

paragraphs.en: A pair of bills sponsored by Massachusetts state Senator Jason Lewis and House Speaker Pro Tempore Patricia Haddad, to ensure "gender parity" on boards and commissions, provides a case in point.
paragraphs.zh: 由Massachusetts州参议员Jason Lewis和众议院临时议长Patricia Haddad提案的两项法案,旨在确保董事会和委员会的"性别平等",便是一个典型例证。

paragraphs.en: Haddad and Lewis are concerned that more than half the state-government boards are less than 40 percent female. In order to ensure that elite women have more such opportunities, they have proposed imposing government quotas. If the bills become law, state boards and commissions will be required to set aside 50 percent of board seats for women by 2022.
paragraphs.zh: Haddad和Lewis担心该州一半以上的政府董事会女性比例不足40%。为了确保精英女性获得更多这样的机会,他们提议实施政府配额制度。如果这些法案成为法律,州董事会和委员会将被要求在2022年前将50%的董事会席位留给女性。

paragraphs.en: The bills are similar to a measure recently adopted in California, which last year became the first state to require gender quotas for private companies. In signing the measure, California Governor Jerry Brown admitted that the law, which expressly classifies people on the basis of sex, is probably unconstitutional.
paragraphs.zh: 这些法案类似于California最近通过的一项措施,该州去年成为第一个要求私营公司实行性别配额的州。在签署该措施时,California州长Jerry Brown承认,这项明确按性别对人进行分类的法律可能违宪。

paragraphs.en: The US Supreme Court frowns on sex-based classifications unless they are designed to address an "important" policy interest. Because the California law applies to all boards, even where there is no history of prior discrimination, courts are likely to rule that the law violates the constitutional guarantee of "equal protection".
paragraphs.zh: 美国最高法院不赞成基于性别的分类,除非这些分类旨在解决"重要的"政策利益。由于California的法律适用于所有董事会,即使在没有先前歧视历史的情况下,法院也可能裁定该法律违反了"平等保护"的宪法保障。

paragraphs.en: But are such government mandates even necessary? Female participation on corporate boards may not currently mirror the percentage of women in the general population, but so what?
paragraphs.zh: 但这种政府强制措施真的有必要吗?企业董事会中的女性参与率目前可能并未反映女性在总人口中的比例,但那又如何?

paragraphs.en: The number of women on corporate boards has been steadily increasing without government interference. According to a study by Catalyst, between 2010 and 2015 the share of women on the boards of global corporations increased by 54 percent.
paragraphs.zh: 在没有政府干预的情况下,企业董事会中的女性人数一直在稳步增加。根据Catalyst的一项研究,2010年至2015年间,全球企业董事会中女性的比例增加了54%。

paragraphs.en: Requiring companies to make gender the primary qualification for board membership will inevitably lead to less experienced private sector boards. That is exactly what happened when Norway adopted a nationwide corporate gender quota.
paragraphs.zh: 要求公司将性别作为董事会成员资格的首要条件,将不可避免地导致私营部门董事会经验不足。这正是Norway采用全国性企业性别配额时发生的情况。

paragraphs.en: Writing in The New Republic, Alice Lee notes that increasing the number of opportunities for board membership without increasing the pool of qualified women to serve on such boards has led to a "golden skirt" phenomenon, where the same elite women scoop up multiple seats on a variety of boards.
paragraphs.zh: Alice Lee在The New Republic撰文指出,在没有增加合格女性人才储备的情况下增加董事会成员的机会数量,导致了"金裙子"现象,即同一批精英女性在各种董事会中占据多个席位。

paragraphs.en: Next time somebody pushes corporate quotas as a way to promote gender equity, remember that such policies are largely self-serving measures that make their sponsors feel good but do little to help average women.
paragraphs.zh: 下次有人推动企业配额制度作为促进性别平等的方式时,请记住,这类政策在很大程度上是自利性措施,让提案者感觉良好,但对普通女性帮助甚微。

reading.title: Text 4
reading.passage: Last Thursday, the French Senate passed a digital services tax, which would impose an entirely new tax on large multinationals that provide digital services to consumers or users in France. Digital services include everything from providing a platform for selling goods and services online to targeting advertising based on user data, and the tax applies to gross revenue from such services. Many French politicians and media outlets have referred to this as a "GAFA tax," meaning that it is designed to apply primarily to companies such as Google, Apple, Facebook and Amazon—in other words, multinational tech companies based in the United States. The digital services tax now awaits the signature of President Emmanuel Macron, who has expressed support for the measure, and it could go into effect within the next few weeks. But it has already sparked significant controversy, with the United States trade representative opening an investigation into whether the tax discriminates against American companies, which in turn could lead to trade sanctions against France. The French tax is not just a unilateral move by one country in need of revenue. Instead, the digital services tax is part of a much larger trend, with countries over the past few years proposing or putting in place an alphabet soup of new international tax provisions. They have included Britain's DPT. (diverted profits tax), Australia's MAAL (multinational anti-avoidance law), and India's SEP (significant economic presence) test, to name but a few. At the same time, the European Union, Spain, Britain and several other countries have all seriously contemplated digital services taxes. These unilateral developments differ in their specifics, but they are all designed to tax multinationals on income and revenue that countries believe they should have a right to tax, even if international tax rules do not grant them that right. In other words, they all share a view that the international tax system has failed to keep up with the current economy. In response to these many unilateral measures, the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) is currently working with 131 countries to reach a consensus by the end of 2020 on an international solution. Both France and the United States are involved in the organization's work, but France's digital services tax and the American response raise questions about what the future holds for the international tax system. France's planned tax is a clear warning: Unless a broad consensus can be reached on reforming the international tax system, other nations are likely to follow suit, and American companies will face a cascade of different taxes from dozens of nations that will prove burdensome and costly.

questions.stem: The French Senate has passed a bill to____
options: C) impose a levy on tech multinationals.
D) curb the influence of advertising.
questions.explanation: 第 36 题是细节题，正确答案 C）impose a levy on tech multinationals. 定位句在第 1 段：上周四，法国参议院通过了一项数字服务税法案，该税将对在法国为消费者或用户提供数字服务的大型跨国公司征收一项全新税种。正确项与原文构成同义替换（impose an entirely new tax on large multinationals that provide digital services ↔ impose a levy on tech multinationals）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、B 项属无中生有、D 项属以偏概全，均可排除。

questions.stem: It can be learned from Paragraph 2 that the digital services tax____
options: A) may trigger countermeasures against France.
B) is apt to arouse criticism at home and abroad.
C) aims to ease international trade tensions.
D) will prompt the tech giants to quit France.
questions.explanation: 第 37 题是推断题，正确答案 A）may trigger countermeasures against France. 定位句在第 2 段：但它已引发巨大争议，美国贸易代表已就该税是否歧视美国公司展开调查，而这反过来可能导致对法国实施贸易制裁。正确项与原文构成同义替换（could lead to trade sanctions against France ↔ may trigger countermeasures against France）。其余三项中，B 项属以偏概全、C 项属与原文相反、D 项属过度推断，均可排除。

questions.stem: The countries adopting the unilateral measures share the opinion that____
options: A) redistribution of tech giants' revenue must be ensured.
B) the current international tax system needs upgrading.
C) tech multinationals' monopoly should be prevented.
D) all countries ought to enjoy equal taxing rights.
questions.explanation: 第 38 题是细节题，正确答案 B）the current international tax system needs upgrading. 定位句在第 4 段：换句话说，它们都持有同一种观点：国际税收体系已经跟不上当下经济。正确项与原文构成同义替换（the international tax system has failed to keep up with the current economy ↔ the current international tax system needs upgrading）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、C 项属偷换概念、D 项属以偏概全，均可排除。

questions.stem: It can be learned from Paragraph 5 that the OECD's current work____
options: A) is being resisted by US companies.
B) needs to be readjusted immediately.
C) is faced with uncertain prospects.
D) needs to involve more countries.
questions.explanation: 第 39 题是推断题，正确答案 C）is faced with uncertain prospects. 定位句在第 5 段：法国和美国都参与该组织的工作，但法国的数字服务税与美方的回应让人对国际税收体系的未来产生疑问。正确项与原文构成同义替换（raise questions about what the future holds for the international tax system ↔ is faced with uncertain prospects）。其余三项中，A 项属张冠李戴、B 项属过度推断、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: Last Thursday, the French Senate passed a digital services tax, which would impose an entirely new tax on large multinationals that provide digital services to consumers or users in France. Digital services include everything from providing a platform for selling goods and services online to targeting advertising based on user data, and the tax applies to gross revenue from such services. Many French politicians and media outlets have referred to this as a "GAFA tax," meaning that it is designed to apply primarily to companies such as Google, Apple, Facebook and Amazon—in other words, multinational tech companies based in the United States.
paragraphs.zh: 上周四,法国参议院通过了一项数字服务税,该税将对在法国向消费者或用户提供数字服务的大型跨国公司征收一种全新的税收。数字服务包括从提供在线销售商品和服务的平台到基于用户数据进行定向广告投放的一切服务,该税适用于此类服务产生的总收入。许多法国政治家和媒体将其称为"GAFA税",意味着它主要针对Google、Apple、Facebook和Amazon等公司,换句话说,就是总部设在美国的跨国科技公司。

paragraphs.en: The digital services tax now awaits the signature of President Emmanuel Macron, who has expressed support for the measure, and it could go into effect within the next few weeks. But it has already sparked significant controversy, with the United States trade representative opening an investigation into whether the tax discriminates against American companies, which in turn could lead to trade sanctions against France.
paragraphs.zh: 数字服务税目前正等待总统Emmanuel Macron的签署,他已表示支持这项措施,该税可能在未来几周内生效。但它已经引发了重大争议,美国贸易代表已启动调查,以确定该税是否歧视美国公司,这反过来可能导致对法国实施贸易制裁。

paragraphs.en: The French tax is not just a unilateral move by one country in need of revenue. Instead, the digital services tax is part of a much larger trend, with countries over the past few years proposing or putting in place an alphabet soup of new international tax provisions. They have included Britain's DPT. (diverted profits tax), Australia's MAAL (multinational anti-avoidance law), and India's SEP (significant economic presence) test, to name but a few. At the same time, the European Union, Spain, Britain and several other countries have all seriously contemplated digital services taxes.
paragraphs.zh: 法国税收不仅仅是一个需要收入的国家的单边行动。相反,数字服务税是一个更大趋势的一部分,过去几年来,各国提出或实施了一系列新的国际税收条款。其中包括英国的DPT(利润转移税)、澳大利亚的MAAL(跨国反避税法)和印度的SEP(重大经济存在)测试,仅举几例。与此同时,欧盟、西班牙、英国和其他几个国家都认真考虑过数字服务税。

paragraphs.en: These unilateral developments differ in their specifics, but they are all designed to tax multinationals on income and revenue that countries believe they should have a right to tax, even if international tax rules do not grant them that right. In other words, they all share a view that the international tax system has failed to keep up with the current economy.
paragraphs.zh: 这些单边发展在具体内容上有所不同,但它们都旨在对跨国公司的收入和营收征税,各国认为它们应该有权征税,即使国际税收规则没有赋予它们这种权利。换句话说,它们都认为国际税收体系未能跟上当前经济的发展。

paragraphs.en: In response to these many unilateral measures, the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) is currently working with 131 countries to reach a consensus by the end of 2020 on an international solution. Both France and the United States are involved in the organization's work, but France's digital services tax and the American response raise questions about what the future holds for the international tax system.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些众多的单边措施,经济合作与发展组织(OECD)目前正在与131个国家合作,争取在2020年底前就国际解决方案达成共识。法国和美国都参与了该组织的工作,但法国的数字服务税和美国的回应引发了关于国际税收体系未来走向的疑问。

paragraphs.en: France's planned tax is a clear warning: Unless a broad consensus can be reached on reforming the international tax system, other nations are likely to follow suit, and American companies will face a cascade of different taxes from dozens of nations that will prove burdensome and costly.
paragraphs.zh: 法国计划征收的税收是一个明确的警告:除非能就改革国际税收体系达成广泛共识,否则其他国家很可能会效仿,美国公司将面临来自数十个国家的一系列不同税收,这将证明既繁重又昂贵。

blanks.explanation: 第 1 空正确答案 B）On。具体某一天前用 on。其余三项：A）In in 不接具体某一天、C）Till till 表'直到'，语义不通、D）Towards towards 表方向/临近，不合，均可排除。
第 2 空正确答案 A）match。few + can，表'几乎没有别的能比得上'。其余三项：B）express express=表达，主宾不通、C）satisfy satisfy=满足，逻辑反了、D）influence influence=影响，与赞美无关，均可排除。
第 3 空正确答案 D）enjoyment。this 回指'美食之乐'，后文又称 guilty pleasure。其余三项：A）patience patience=耐心，与美食无关、B）concern concern=担忧，色彩相反、C）surprise surprise=惊喜，不是回指对象，均可排除。
第 4 空正确答案 B）guaranteed。讽刺语气：被'认定'必然损害健康。其余三项：A）intensified intensify 不接 to do、C）compelled compel 接人，对象不对、D）privileged privileged 色彩相反，均可排除。
第 5 空正确答案 C）issued。下文全是 FSA 在劝告公众，说明它'发出'了警告。其余三项：A）ignored ignored=无视，与下文劝告矛盾、B）received received=收到，方向反了、D）cancelled cancelled=取消，与下文矛盾，均可排除。
第 6 空正确答案 D）at。at + 温度，表'在某温度下'。其余三项：A）under under 不接温度量、B）by by 表方式/幅度，不合、C）for for 表时长/目的，不对，均可排除。
第 7 空正确答案 B）avoid。并列 reject、only partially，全是'少做/别做'。其余三项：A）forget forget doing=忘记做过，不合劝告、C）finish finish=做完，方向相反、D）regret regret doing=后悔，不是劝诫，均可排除。
第 8 空正确答案 C）partially。only + 减害基调，要'只稍微烤'。其余三项：A）easily easily=轻易地，与减害无关、B）regularly regularly=经常，方向相反、D）initially initially=起初，时间义不合，均可排除。
第 9 空正确答案 C）While。前句'对老鼠有害'、后句'对人无致癌证据'，是对比让步。其余三项：A）If If=如果，引条件不引对比、B）Since Since=因为，强加因果、D）Unless Unless=除非，逻辑不通，均可排除。
第 10 空正确答案 A）conclusive。下文'无确凿科学证明'同义复现。其余三项：B）external external=外部的，论点无关、C）secondary secondary=次要的，偏离重点、D）negative negative=否定的，与 no 冲突，均可排除。
第 11 空正确答案 A）likely。but no hard proof，说明只是'有可能'。其余三项：B）bound be bound to=必定，语气过强、C）insufficient insufficient 不接 to cause cancer、D）slow slow=缓慢的，语义不通，均可排除。
第 12 空正确答案 C）On the basis of。凭原则得出'宜遵循建议'，是'依据'关系。其余三项：A）In addition to In addition to=除……之外，无补充关系、B）At the cost of At the cost of=以……为代价，无牺牲义、D）In contrast to In contrast to=与……相反，无对比，均可排除。
第 13 空正确答案 D）advisable。基于预防原则，遵循建议是'明智可取的'。其余三项：A）interesting interesting=有趣的，评价维度错、B）fortunate fortunate=幸运的，语义不通、C）urgent urgent=紧急的，程度过强，均可排除。
第 14 空正确答案 B）After all。吸烟致癌'先有传言后有证据'，为前句论点提供佐证。其余三项：A）As usual As usual=像往常一样，无常态义、C）By definition By definition=根据定义，无定义推演、D）In particular In particular=尤其，无特指强调，均可排除。
第 15 空正确答案 A）connection。前文 smoking caused cancer，要证'两者有关联'。其余三项：B）combination combination=组合，非两者关系、C）resemblance resemblance=相似，语义不符、D）pattern pattern=模式，不指因果关联，均可排除。
第 16 空正确答案 D）served。宾语是食物、地点是 on Sunday 餐桌情境。其余三项：A）made make up=编造/组成，义不符、B）used use up=用尽，对象不对、C）saved save up=攒钱/储存，义不符，均可排除。
第 17 空正确答案 C）To be fair。前文一直批 FSA，此处替它说句公道话。其余三项：A）To be brief To be brief=简言之，无概括功能、B）For instance For instance=例如，后句非举例、D）In general In general=总体而言，无公允义，均可排除。

reading.title: Text 1
reading.passage: Rats and other animals need to be highly attuned to social signals from others so they can identify friends to cooperate with and enemies to avoid. To find out if this extends to non-living beings, Laleh Quinn at the University of California, San Diego, and her colleagues tested whether rats can detect social signals from robotic rats. They housed eight adult rats with two types of robotic rat—one social and one asocial—for four days. The robot rats were quite minimalist, resembling a chunkier version of a computer mouse with wheels to move around and colourful markings. During the experiment, the social robot rat followed the living rats around, played with the same toys, and opened cage doors to let trapped rats escape. Meanwhile, the asocial robot simply moved forwards and backwards and side to side. Next, the researchers trapped the robots in cages and gave the rats the opportunity to release them by pressing a lever. Across 18 trials each, the living rats were 52 percent more likely on average to set the social robot free than the asocial one. This suggests that the rats perceived the social robot as a genuine social being, says Quinn. The rats may have bonded more with the social robot because it displayed behaviors like communal exploring and playing. This could lead to the rats better remembering having freed it earlier, and wanting the robot to return the favour when they get trapped, she says. "Rats have been shown to engage in multiple forms of reciprocal help and cooperation, including what is referred to as direct reciprocity where a rat will help another rat that has previously helped them," says Quinn. The readiness of the rats to befriend the social robot was surprising given its minimal design. The robot was the same size as a regular rat but resembled a simple plastic box on wheels. "We'd assumed we'd have to give it a moving head and tail, facial features, and put a scent on it to make it smell like a real rat, but that wasn't necessary," says Janet Wiles at the University of Queensland in Australia, who helped with the research. The finding shows how sensitive rats are to social cues, even when they come from basic robots. Similarly, children tend to treat robots as if they are fellow beings, even when they display only simple social signals. "We humans seem to be fascinated by robots, and it turns out other animals are too," says Wiles.

To find out if this extends to non-living beings, Laleh Quinn at the University of California, San Diego, and her colleagues tested whether rats can detect social signals from robotic rats.
paragraphs.zh: 老鼠和其他动物需要高度关注来自同类的社交信号,以便识别可以合作的朋友和需要避开的敌人。为了弄清这是否延伸到非生命体,加州大学圣地亚哥分校的Laleh Quinn和她的同事们测试了老鼠是否能够检测到来自机器老鼠的社交信号。

paragraphs.en: They housed eight adult rats with two types of robotic rat—one social and one asocial—for four days. The robot rats were quite minimalist, resembling a chunkier version of a computer mouse with wheels to move around and colourful markings.
paragraphs.zh: 他们让八只成年老鼠与两种类型的机器老鼠——一种社交型和一种非社交型——共同生活了四天。这些机器老鼠相当简约,像是一个带轮子可以四处移动、有彩色标记的加厚版电脑鼠标。

paragraphs.en: During the experiment, the social robot rat followed the living rats around, played with the same toys, and opened cage doors to let trapped rats escape. Meanwhile, the asocial robot simply moved forwards and backwards and side to side.
paragraphs.zh: 在实验期间,社交型机器老鼠跟随真老鼠四处走动,玩相同的玩具,并打开笼门让被困的老鼠逃出。与此同时,非社交型机器只是简单地前后和左右移动。

paragraphs.en: Next, the researchers trapped the robots in cages and gave the rats the opportunity to release them by pressing a lever. Across 18 trials each, the living rats were 52 percent more likely on average to set the social robot free than the asocial one. This suggests that the rats perceived the social robot as a genuine social being, says Quinn. The rats may have bonded more with the social robot because it displayed behaviors like communal exploring and playing. This could lead to the rats better remembering having freed it earlier, and wanting the robot to return the favour when they get trapped, she says.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来,研究人员将机器困在笼子里,让老鼠有机会通过按压杠杆释放它们。在各18次试验中,真老鼠释放社交型机器的可能性平均比释放非社交型机器高52%。Quinn说,这表明老鼠将社交型机器视为真正的社交生物。老鼠可能与社交型机器建立了更深的联系,因为它表现出了诸如共同探索和玩耍等行为。她说,这可能导致老鼠更好地记住之前曾释放过它,并希望当自己被困时机器能够回报这份恩惠。

paragraphs.en: "Rats have been shown to engage in multiple forms of reciprocal help and cooperation, including what is referred to as direct reciprocity where a rat will help another rat that has previously helped them," says Quinn.
paragraphs.zh: Quinn说:"研究表明,老鼠会参与多种形式的互惠帮助和合作,包括所谓的直接互惠,即一只老鼠会帮助曾经帮助过自己的另一只老鼠。"

paragraphs.en: The readiness of the rats to befriend the social robot was surprising given its minimal design. The robot was the same size as a regular rat but resembled a simple plastic box on wheels. "We'd assumed we'd have to give it a moving head and tail, facial features, and put a scent on it to make it smell like a real rat, but that wasn't necessary," says Janet Wiles at the University of Queensland in Australia, who helped with the research.
paragraphs.zh: 考虑到机器的简约设计,老鼠愿意与社交型机器交朋友令人惊讶。这个机器与普通老鼠大小相同,但看起来像一个装在轮子上的简单塑料盒。参与这项研究的澳大利亚昆士兰大学的Janet Wiles说:"我们原本以为必须给它安装一个能动的头和尾巴、面部特征,并在它身上喷洒气味使其闻起来像真老鼠,但这些都不必要。"

paragraphs.en: The finding shows how sensitive rats are to social cues, even when they come from basic robots. Similarly, children tend to treat robots as if they are fellow beings, even when they display only simple social signals. "We humans seem to be fascinated by robots, and it turns out other animals are too," says Wiles.
paragraphs.zh: 这一发现显示了老鼠对社交线索的敏感程度,即使这些线索来自基本的机器。同样,儿童往往会把机器当作同类对待,即使它们只展示简单的社交信号。Wiles说:"我们人类似乎对机器着迷,事实证明其他动物也是如此。"

reading.title: Text 2
reading.passage: It is true that CEO pay has gone up—top ones may make 300 times the pay of typical workers on average, and since the mid-1970s, CEO pay for large publicly traded American corporations has, by varying estimates, gone up by about 500%. The typical CEO of a top American corporation now makes about $18.9 million a year. The best model for understanding the growth of CEO pay is that of limited CEO talent in a world where business opportunities for the top firms are growing rapidly. The efforts of America's highest-earning 1% have been one of the more dynamic elements of the global economy. It's not popular to say, but one reason their pay has gone up so much is that CEOs really have upped their game relative to many other workers in the U.S. economy. Today's CEO, at least for major American firms, must have many more skills than simply being able to "run the company." CEOs must have a good sense of financial markets and maybe even how the company should trade in them. They also need better public relations skills than their predecessors, as the costs of even a minor slipup can be significant. Then there's the fact that large American companies are much more globalized than ever before, with supply chains spread across a larger number of countries. To lead in that system requires knowledge that is fairly mind-boggling. Plus, virtually all major American companies are becoming tech companies, one way or another. Beyond this, major CEOs still have to do all the day-to-day work they have always done. The common idea that high CEO pay is mainly about ripping people off doesn't explain history very well. By most measures, corporate governance has become a lot tighter and more rigorous since the 1970s. Yet it is principally during this period of stronger governance that CEO pay has been high and rising. That suggests it is in the broader corporate interest to recruit top candidates for increasingly tough jobs. Furthermore, the highest CEO salaries are paid to outside candidates, not to the cozy insider picks, another sign that high CEO pay is not some kind of depredation at the expense of the rest of the company. And the stock market reacts positively when companies tie CEO pay to, say, stock prices, a sign that those practices build up corporate value not just for the CEO.

They also need better public relations skills than their predecessors, as the costs of even a minor slipup can be significant. Then there's the fact that large American companies are much more globalized than ever before, with supply chains spread across a larger number of countries. To lead in that system requires knowledge that is fairly mind-boggling. Plus, virtually all major American companies are becoming tech companies, one way or another. paragraphs.zh: 此外,最高的CEO薪酬支付给外部候选人,而不是内部亲信人选,这是高CEO薪酬并非以牺牲公司其他部分为代价进行掠夺的另一个迹象。而且当公司将CEO薪酬与股价等指标挂钩时,股市会做出积极反应,这表明这些做法不仅为CEO,也为公司建立了企业价值。

reading.title: Text 3
reading.passage: Madrid was hailed as a public health beacon last November when it rolled out ambitious restrictions on the most polluting cars. Seven months and one election day later, a new conservative city council suspended enforcement of the clean air zone, a first step toward its possible demise. Mayor José Luis Martinez-Almeida made opposition to the zone a centrepiece of his election campaign, despite its success in improving air quality. A judge has now overruled the city's decision to stop levying fines, ordering them reinstated. But with legal battles ahead, the zone's future looks uncertain at best. Madrid's back and forth on clean air is a pointed reminder of the limits to the patchwork, city-by-city approach that characterises efforts on air pollution across Europe, Britain very much included. Among other weaknesses, the measures cities must employ when left to tackle dirty air on their own are politically controversial, and therefore vulnerable. That's because they inevitably put the costs of cleaning the air on to individual drivers—who must pay fees or buy better vehicles—rather than on to the car manufacturers whose cheating is the real cause of our toxic pollution. It's not hard to imagine a similar reversal happening in London. The new ultra-low emission zone (Ulez) is likely to be a big issue in next year's mayoral election. And if Sadiq Khan wins and extends it to the North and South Circular roads in 2021 as he intends, it is sure to spark intense opposition from the far larger number of motorists who will then be affected. It's not that measures such as London's Ulez are useless. Far from it. Local officials are using the levers that are available to them to safeguard residents' health in the face of a serious threat. The zones do deliver some improvements to air quality, and the science tells us that means real health benefits. But mayors and councilors can only do so much about a problem that is far bigger than any one city or town. They are acting because national governments—Britain's and others across Europe—have failed to do so. Restrictions that keep highly polluting cars out of certain areas—city centres, "school streets", even individual roads—are a response to the absence of a larger effort to properly enforce existing regulations and require auto companies to bring their vehicles into compliance. Wales has introduced special low speed limits to minimise pollution. We're doing everything but insist that manufacturers clean up their cars.

questions.stem: Which of the following is true about Madrid's clean air zone?
options: B) It has been opposed by a judge.
D) Its fate is yet to be decided.
questions.explanation: 第 31 题是细节题，正确答案 D）Its fate is yet to be decided. 定位句在第 1 段：但鉴于后续还有法律拉锯战，该清洁空气区的未来充其量仍是不确定的。正确项与原文构成同义替换（the zone's future looks uncertain at best ↔ Its fate is yet to be decided；But with legal battles ahead ↔ yet to be decided）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属张冠李戴、C 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: Which is considered a weakness of the city-level measures to tackle dirty air?
options: A) They are biased against car manufacturers.
B) They prove impractical for city councils.
C) They are deemed too mild for politicians.
D) They put too much burden on individual motorists.
questions.explanation: 第 32 题是细节题，正确答案 D）They put too much burden on individual motorists. 定位句在第 3 段：这是因为这些措施不可避免地把治理空气的成本压到了个体司机头上——他们要么交罚款要么买更好的车——而不是压到汽车制造商头上，而厂商的造假才是我们这场毒害性污染的真正根源。正确项与原文构成同义替换（put the costs of cleaning the air on to individual drivers ↔ put too much burden on individual motorists）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属无中生有、C 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: The author believes that the extension of London's Ulez will ____.
questions.explanation: 第 33 题是细节题，正确答案 A）arouse strong resistance 定位句在第 3 段：如果萨迪克·汗连任并且按他打算的那样在 2021 年把该区扩展到南北环路，那么这必将激起届时受到影响的更大规模车主群体的强烈反对。正确项与原文构成同义替换（it is sure to spark intense opposition ↔ arouse strong resistance）。其余三项中，B 项属无中生有、C 项属偷换概念、D 项属过度推断，均可排除。

questions.stem: Who does the author think should have addressed the problem?
questions.explanation: 第 34 题是细节题，正确答案 D）National governments. 定位句在第 5 段：他们（市长和议员）之所以出手，是因为国家政府——英国的以及欧洲其他国家的——没能出手。正确项与原文构成同义替换（national governments ↔ National governments；have failed to do so ↔ should have addressed the problem）。其余三项中，A 项属答非所问、B 项属与原文相反、C 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: It can be inferred from the last paragraph that auto companies ____.
options: A) will raise low-emission car production
B) should be forced to follow regulations
C) will upgrade the design of their vehicles
D) should be put under public supervision
questions.explanation: 第 35 题是推断题，正确答案 B）should be forced to follow regulations 定位句在第 6 段：我们什么都做了，唯独没有坚持让汽车制造商把车整改干净。正确项与原文构成同义替换（require auto companies to bring their vehicles into compliance ↔ should be forced to follow regulations；insist that manufacturers clean up their cars ↔ should be forced to follow regulations）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、C 项属无中生有、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: Madrid was hailed as a public health beacon last November when it rolled out ambitious restrictions on the most polluting cars. Seven months and one election day later, a new conservative city council suspended enforcement of the clean air zone, a first step toward its possible demise. Mayor José Luis Martinez-Almeida made opposition to the zone a centrepiece of his election campaign, despite its success in improving air quality. A judge has now overruled the city's decision to stop levying fines, ordering them reinstated. But with legal battles ahead, the zone's future looks uncertain at best.
paragraphs.zh: 去年11月,马德里因推出针对污染最严重车辆的雄心勃勃的限制措施而被誉为公共健康的灯塔。七个月和一个选举日之后,新的保守派市议会暂停了清洁空气区的执法,这是该措施可能终止的第一步。尽管该区域在改善空气质量方面取得了成功,市长José Luis Martinez-Almeida仍将反对该区域作为其竞选活动的核心内容。现在,一名法官推翻了该市停止征收罚款的决定,下令恢复罚款。但随着法律纠纷的到来,该区域的未来充其量看起来并不确定。
