paragraphs.en: It's not difficult to set targets for staff. It is much harder, [1] , to understand their negative consequences. Most work-related behaviors have multiple components. [2] one and the others become distorted.
paragraphs.zh: 为员工设定目标并不困难。然而，理解这些目标的负面后果却要困难得多。大多数与工作相关的行为都有多个组成部分。强调其中一个,其他部分就会变得扭曲。

paragraphs.en: Travel on a London bus and you'll [3] see how this works with drivers. Watch people get on and show their tickets. Are they carefully inspected? Never. Do people get on without paying? Of course! Are there inspectors to [4] that people have paid? Possibly, but very few. And people who run for the bus? They are [5] . How about jumping lights? Buses do so almost as frequently as cyclists.
paragraphs.zh: 乘坐伦敦公交车,你很快就会看到这在司机身上是如何体现的。观察人们上车并出示车票。车票会被仔细检查吗?从来不会。有人不付钱就上车吗?当然有!有检票员检查人们是否付费吗?可能有,但非常少。那些追赶公交车的人呢?他们被忽视了。闯红灯呢?公交车闯红灯的频率几乎和骑自行车的人一样高。

paragraphs.en: Why? Because the target is [6] . People complained that buses were late and infrequent. [7] , the number of buses and bus lanes was increased, and drivers were [8] or punished according to the time they took. And drivers hit these targets. But they [9] hit cyclists. If the target was changed to [10] , you would have more inspectors and more sensitive pricing. If the criterion changed to safety, you would get more [11] drivers who obeyed traffic laws. But both these criteria would be at the expense of time.
paragraphs.zh: 为什么?因为目标是准点。人们抱怨公交车晚点且班次不频繁。因此,公交车数量和公交专用道增加了,司机根据他们所花费的时间受到奖励或惩罚。司机们达到了这些目标。但他们也撞到了骑自行车的人。如果目标改为收入,你会有更多检票员和更灵活的定价。如果标准改为安全,你会得到更谨慎、遵守交通法规的司机。但这两个标准都将以时间为代价。

paragraphs.en: There is another [12] : people became immensely inventive in hitting targets. Have you [13] that you can leave on a flight an hour late but still arrive on time? Tailwinds? Of course not! Airlines have simply changed the time a [14] is meant to take. A one-hour flight is now billed as a two-hour flight.
paragraphs.zh: 还有另一个问题:人们在达成目标方面变得极其善于创新。你有没有注意到,你可以晚一个小时起飞但仍能准点到达?顺风?当然不是!航空公司只是改变了行程应该花费的时间。一小时的航班现在被标注为两小时的航班。

paragraphs.en: The [15] of the story is simple. Most jobs are multidimensional, with multiple criteria. Choose one criterion and you may well [16] others. Everything can be done faster and made cheaper, but there is a [17] . Setting targets can and does have unforeseen negative consequences.
paragraphs.zh: 这个故事的寓意很简单。大多数工作都是多维度的,有多个标准。选择一个标准,你很可能会牺牲其他标准。一切都可以做得更快、成本更低,但这是有代价的。设定目标可能而且确实会产生意想不到的负面后果。

paragraphs.en: This is not an argument against target-setting. But it is an argument for exploring consequences first. All good targets should have multiple criteria [18] critical factors such as time, money, quality and customer feedback. The trick is not only to [19] just one or even two dimensions of the objective, but also to understand how to help people better [20] the objective.
paragraphs.zh: 这并不是反对设定目标的论点。但这是一个主张首先探讨后果的论点。所有好的目标都应该有与时间、金钱、质量和客户反馈等关键因素相关的多个标准。诀窍不仅在于只明确目标的一个甚至两个维度,还在于理解如何帮助人们更好地实现目标。

reading.title: Text 1
reading.passage: People often complain that plastics are too durable. Water bottles, shopping bags, and other trash litter the planet, from Mount Everest to the Mariana Trench, because plastics are everywhere and don't break down easily. But some plastic materials change over time. They crack and frizzle. They "weep" out additives. They melt into sludge. All of which creates huge headaches for institutions, such as museums, trying to preserve culturally important objects. The variety of plastic objects at risk is dizzying: early radios, avant-garde sculptures, celluloid animation stills from Disney films, the first artificial heart. Certain artifacts are especially vulnerable because some pioneers in plastic art didn't always know how to mix ingredients properly, says Thea van Oosten, a polymer chemist who, until retiring a few years ago, worked for decades at the Cultural Heritage Agency of the Netherlands (RCE). "It's like baking a cake: If you don't have exact amounts, it goes wrong," she says. "The object you make is already a time bomb." And sometimes, it's not the artist's fault. In the 1960s, the Italian artist Piero Gilardi began to create hundreds of bright, colorful foam pieces. Those pieces included small beds of roses and other items as well as a few dozen "nature carpets"—large rectangles decorated with foam pumpkins, cabbages, and watermelons. He wanted viewers to walk around on the carpets—which meant they had to be durable. Unfortunately, the polyurethane foam he used is inherently unstable. It's especially vulnerable to light damage, and by the mid-1990s, Gilardi's pumpkins, roses, and other figures were splitting and crumbling. Museums locked some of them away in the dark. So van Oosten and colleagues worked to preserve Gilardi's sculptures. They infused some with stabilizing and consolidating chemicals. Van Oosten calls those chemicals "sunscreens" because their goal was to prevent further light damage and rebuild worn polymer fibers. She is proud that several sculptures have even gone on display again, albeit sometimes beneath protective cases. Despite success stories like van Oosten's, preservation of plastics will likely get harder. Old objects continue to deteriorate. Worse, biodegradable plastics, designed to disintegrate, are increasingly common. And more is at stake here than individual objects. Joana Lia Ferreira, an assistant professor of conservation and restoration at the NOVA School of Science and Technology, notes that archaeologists first defined the great material ages of human history—Stone Age, Iron Age, and so on—after examining artifacts in museums. We now live in an age of plastic, she says, "and what we decide to collect today, what we decide to preserve…will have a strong impact on how in the future we'll be seen."

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 1, museums are faced with difficulties in____
questions.explanation: 第 21 题是细节题，正确答案 A）maintaining their plastic items. 定位句在第 1 段：所有这些（塑料的老化变化）给那些试图保存具有文化重要性的物品的机构（例如博物馆）带来了巨大的麻烦。正确项与原文构成同义替换（trying to preserve culturally important objects ↔ maintaining their plastic items）。其余三项中，B 项属与原文相反、C 项属偷换概念、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: Van Oosten believes that certain plastic objects are____
questions.explanation: 第 22 题是细节题，正确答案 C）inherently flawed. 定位句在第 2 段：她说：这就像烤蛋糕，如果你的用量不准，就会出错。你做出来的物件本身就已经是一颗定时炸弹了。正确项与原文构成同义替换（The object you make is already a time bomb ↔ inherently flawed；If you don't have exact amounts, it goes wrong ↔ inherently flawed）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属偷换概念、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: Museums stopped exhibiting some of Gilardi's artworks to____
options: A) keep them from hurting visitors.
B) duplicate them for future display.
D) prevent them from further damage.
questions.explanation: 第 23 题是细节题，正确答案 D）prevent them from further damage. 定位句在第 4 段：这种聚氨酯泡沫特别容易受光损伤，到 1990 年代中期，Gilardi 的南瓜、玫瑰等造型已经开裂、碎裂。博物馆于是把其中一些锁进了暗处。正确项与原文构成同义替换（Museums locked some of them away in the dark ↔ prevent them from further damage；especially vulnerable to light damage ↔ prevent them from further damage）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属无中生有、C 项属张冠李戴，均可排除。

questions.stem: The author thinks that preservation of plastics is____
questions.explanation: 第 24 题是细节题，正确答案 D）challenging. 定位句在第 6 段：尽管有像 Van Oosten 这样的成功案例，塑料保存工作仍然可能变得越来越棘手。正确项与原文构成同义替换（preservation of plastics will likely get harder ↔ challenging；Old objects continue to deteriorate ↔ challenging）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属与原文相反、C 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: In Ferreira's opinion, preservation of plastic artifacts____
options: A) will inspire future scientific research.
C) will help us separate the material ages.
D) has an impact on today's cultural life.
questions.explanation: 第 25 题是细节题，正确答案 B）has profound historical significance. 定位句在第 7 段：她说，我们如今生活在塑料时代，我们今天决定收藏什么、决定保存什么，将对未来人如何看待我们产生深远影响。正确项与原文构成同义替换（archaeologists first defined the great material ages of human history ↔ has profound historical significance；will have a strong impact on how in the future we'll be seen ↔ has profound historical significance）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、C 项属过度推断、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: People often complain that plastics are too durable. Water bottles, shopping bags, and other trash litter the planet, from Mount Everest to the Mariana Trench, because plastics are everywhere and don't break down easily. But some plastic materials change over time. They crack and frizzle. They "weep" out additives. They melt into sludge. All of which creates huge headaches for institutions, such as museums, trying to preserve culturally important objects. The variety of plastic objects at risk is dizzying: early radios, avant-garde sculptures, celluloid animation stills from Disney films, the first artificial heart.
paragraphs.zh: 人们常常抱怨塑料太耐久。从珠穆朗玛峰到马里亚纳海沟,水瓶、购物袋和其他垃圾遍布地球,因为塑料无处不在且不易分解。但有些塑料材料会随时间而变化。它们开裂、碎裂。它们"渗出"添加剂。它们融化成污泥。所有这些都给博物馆等试图保存文化重要物品的机构带来了巨大的麻烦。面临风险的塑料物品种类繁多:早期收音机、前卫雕塑、迪士尼电影的赛璐珞动画静帧、第一颗人造心脏。

paragraphs.en: Certain artifacts are especially vulnerable because some pioneers in plastic art didn't always know how to mix ingredients properly, says Thea van Oosten, a polymer chemist who, until retiring a few years ago, worked for decades at the Cultural Heritage Agency of the Netherlands (RCE). "It's like baking a cake: If you don't have exact amounts, it goes wrong," she says. "The object you make is already a time bomb."
paragraphs.zh: 某些文物尤其脆弱,因为一些塑料艺术的先驱并不总是知道如何正确混合成分,荷兰文化遗产局(RCE)的高分子化学家Thea van Oosten说,她在几年前退休之前在该机构工作了数十年。"这就像烤蛋糕:如果你没有精确的用量,就会出问题,"她说。"你制作的物品本身就是一个定时炸弹。"

paragraphs.en: And sometimes, it's not the artist's fault. In the 1960s, the Italian artist Piero Gilardi began to create hundreds of bright, colorful foam pieces. Those pieces included small beds of roses and other items as well as a few dozen "nature carpets"—large rectangles decorated with foam pumpkins, cabbages, and watermelons. He wanted viewers to walk around on the carpets—which meant they had to be durable.
paragraphs.zh: 有时候,这并不是艺术家的错。20世纪60年代,意大利艺术家Piero Gilardi开始创作数百件明亮多彩的泡沫作品。这些作品包括玫瑰小花坛和其他物品,以及几十张"自然地毯"——装饰有泡沫南瓜、卷心菜和西瓜的大型矩形作品。他希望观众在地毯上走动——这意味着它们必须耐用。

paragraphs.en: Unfortunately, the polyurethane foam he used is inherently unstable. It's especially vulnerable to light damage, and by the mid-1990s, Gilardi's pumpkins, roses, and other figures were splitting and crumbling. Museums locked some of them away in the dark.
paragraphs.zh: 不幸的是,他使用的聚氨酯泡沫本质上是不稳定的。它特别容易受到光损伤,到20世纪90年代中期,Gilardi的南瓜、玫瑰和其他造型开始分裂和碎裂。博物馆把其中一些锁在了黑暗中。

paragraphs.en: So van Oosten and colleagues worked to preserve Gilardi's sculptures. They infused some with stabilizing and consolidating chemicals. Van Oosten calls those chemicals "sunscreens" because their goal was to prevent further light damage and rebuild worn polymer fibers. She is proud that several sculptures have even gone on display again, albeit sometimes beneath protective cases.
paragraphs.zh: 因此van Oosten和同事们致力于保护Gilardi的雕塑。他们向一些雕塑注入了稳定和加固化学物质。van Oosten称这些化学物质为"防晒霜",因为它们的目标是防止进一步的光损伤并重建磨损的聚合物纤维。她自豪地说,几件雕塑甚至再次展出,尽管有时是在保护罩下。

paragraphs.en: Despite success stories like van Oosten's, preservation of plastics will likely get harder. Old objects continue to deteriorate. Worse, biodegradable plastics, designed to disintegrate, are increasingly common.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管有像van Oosten这样的成功案例,塑料的保存可能会变得更加困难。旧物品继续恶化。更糟糕的是,设计用于分解的可生物降解塑料越来越常见。

paragraphs.en: And more is at stake here than individual objects. Joana Lia Ferreira, an assistant professor of conservation and restoration at the NOVA School of Science and Technology, notes that archaeologists first defined the great material ages of human history—Stone Age, Iron Age, and so on—after examining artifacts in museums. We now live in an age of plastic, she says, "and what we decide to collect today, what we decide to preserve…will have a strong impact on how in the future we'll be seen."
paragraphs.zh: 这里涉及的不仅仅是单个物品。NOVA科技学院保护与修复助理教授Joana Lia Ferreira指出,考古学家最初是在检查博物馆文物后定义人类历史上伟大的物质时代——石器时代、铁器时代等等。她说,我们现在生活在塑料时代,"我们今天决定收藏什么,我们决定保存什么……将对未来人们如何看待我们产生重大影响。"

reading.title: Text 2
reading.passage: As the latest crop of students pen their undergraduate application form and weigh up their options, it may be worth considering just how the point, purpose and value of a degree has changed and what Generation Z need to consider as they start the third stage of their educational journey. Millennials were told that if you did well in school, got a decent degree, you would be set up for life. But that promise has been found wanting. As degrees became universal, they became devalued. Education was no longer a secure route of social mobility. Today, 28 per cent of graduates in the UK are in non-graduate roles, a percentage which is double the average among the OECD countries. This is not to say that there is no point in getting a degree, but rather stress that a degree is not for everyone, that the switch from classroom to lecture hall is not an inevitable one and that other options are available. Thankfully, there are signs that this is already happening, with Generation Z seeking to learn from their millennial predecessors, even if parents and teachers tend to be still set in the degree mindset. Employers have long seen the advantages of hiring school leavers who often prove themselves to be more committed and loyal employees than graduates. Many too are seeing the advantages of scrapping a degree requirement for certain roles. For those for whom a degree is the desired route, consider that this may well be the first of many. In this age of generalists, it pays to have specific knowledge or skills. Postgraduates now earn 40 per cent more than graduates. When more and more of us have a degree, it makes sense to have two. It is unlikely that Generation Z will be done with education at 18 or 21; they will need to be constantly upskilling throughout their career to stay employable. It has been estimated that this generation, due to the pressures of technology, the wish for personal fulfilment and desire for diversity, will work for 17 different employers over the course of their working life and have five different careers. Education, and not just knowledge gained on campus, will be a core part of Generation Z's career trajectory. Older generations often talk about their degree in the present and personal tense: 'I am a geographer' or 'I am a classicist'. Their sons or daughters would never say such a thing; it's as if they already know that their degree won't define them in the same way.

questions.stem: The author suggests that Generation Z should____
options: A) be careful in choosing a college.
B) be diligent at each educational stage.
C) reassess the necessity of college education.
questions.explanation: 第 26 题是推断题，正确答案 C）reassess the necessity of college education. 该题需通观全文作答。正确项与原文构成同义替换（a degree is not for everyone ↔ reassess the necessity of college education；other options are available ↔ reassess the necessity of college education）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属偷换概念、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: The percentage of UK graduates in non-graduate roles reflects____

questions.explanation: 第 27 题是细节题，正确答案 B）the shrinking value of a degree. 定位句在第 2 段：但这一承诺已被发现落空。随着学位变得普及，它们也随之贬值。教育不再是社会流动的稳妥途径。如今，英国 28% 的毕业生在做非毕业生岗位，这一比例是 OECD 国家平均值的两倍。正确项与原文构成同义替换（they became devalued ↔ the shrinking value of a degree）。其余三项中，A 项属张冠李戴、C 项属无中生有、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: The author considers it a good sign that____

B) school leavers are willing to be skilled workers.

questions.explanation: 第 28 题是细节题，正确答案 C）employers are taking a realistic attitude to degree. 定位句在第 4 段：雇主们早已看到雇用高中毕业生的好处——他们往往比大学毕业生更敬业、更忠诚；许多雇主也开始看到取消某些岗位学位要求的好处。正确项与原文构成同义替换（scrapping a degree requirement for certain roles ↔ employers are taking a realistic attitude to degree；Employers have long seen the advantages of hiring school leavers ↔ employers are taking a realistic attitude to degree）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属无中生有、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: It is advised in Paragraph 5 that those with one degree should____
options: A) make an early decision on their career.
C) team up with high-paid postgraduates.
D) further their studies in a specific field.
questions.explanation: 第 29 题是细节题，正确答案 D）further their studies in a specific field. 定位句在第 5 段：在通才横行的时代，掌握具体的知识或技能很值钱。研究生现在比本科生多挣 40%。当越来越多的人都有学位时，拥有两个学位就成了合理之举。正确项与原文构成同义替换（specific knowledge or skills ↔ further their studies in a specific field；it makes sense to have two ↔ further their studies）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属偷换概念、C 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

Many too are seeing the advantages of scrapping a degree requirement for certain roles.

paragraphs.en: It is unlikely that Generation Z will be done with education at 18 or 21; they will need to be constantly upskilling throughout their career to stay employable. It has been estimated that this generation, due to the pressures of technology, the wish for personal fulfilment and desire for diversity, will work for 17 different employers over the course of their working life and have five different careers. Education, and not just knowledge gained on campus, will be a core part of Generation Z's career trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: Z世代不太可能在18岁或21岁时就结束教育;他们需要在整个职业生涯中不断提升技能以保持就业能力。据估计,由于技术压力、个人成就感的愿望以及对多样性的渴望,这一代人在其职业生涯中将为17个不同的雇主工作,并拥有五种不同的职业。教育,而不仅仅是在校园获得的知识,将成为Z世代职业轨迹的核心部分。

paragraphs.en: Older generations often talk about their degree in the present and personal tense: 'I am a geographer' or 'I am a classicist'. Their sons or daughters would never say such a thing; it's as if they already know that their degree won't define them in the same way.

reading.title: Text 3
reading.passage: Enlightening, challenging, stimulating, fun. These were some of the words that Nature readers used to describe their experience of art-science collaborations in a series of articles on partnerships between artists and researchers. Nearly 40% of the roughly 350 people who responded to an accompanying poll said they had collaborated with artists; and almost all said they would consider doing so in future. Such an encouraging result is not surprising. Scientists are increasingly seeking out visual artists to help them communicate their work to new audiences. "Artists help scientists reach a broader audience and make emotional connections that enhance learning," one respondent said. One example of how artists and scientists have together rocked the scenes came last month when the Sydney Symphony Orchestra performed a reworked version of Antonio Vivaldi's The Four Seasons. They reimagined the 300-year-old score by injecting the latest climate prediction data for each season—provided by Monash University's Climate Change Communication Research Hub. The performance was a creative call to action ahead of November's United Nations Climate Change Conference in Glasgow, UK. But a genuine partnership must be a two-way street. Fewer artists than scientists responded to the Nature poll; however, several respondents noted that artists do not simply assist scientists with their communication requirements. Nor should their work be considered only as an object of study. The alliances are most valuable when scientists and artists have a shared stake in a project, are able to jointly design it and can critique each other's work. Such an approach can both prompt new research as well as result in powerful art. More than half a century ago, the Massachusetts Institute of Technology opened its Center for Advanced Visual Studies (CAVS) to explore the role of technology in culture. The founders deliberately focused their projects around light—hence the "visual studies" in the name. Light was something that both artists and scientists had an interest in, and therefore could form the basis of collaboration. As science and technology progressed, and divided into more sub-disciplines, the centre was simultaneously looking to a time when leading researchers could also be artists, writers and poets, and vice versa. Nature's poll findings suggest that this trend is as strong as ever, but, to make a collaboration work, both sides need to invest time, and embrace surprise and challenge. The reach of art-science tie-ups needs to go beyond the necessary purpose of research communication, and participants must not fall into the trap of stereotyping each other. Artists and scientists alike are immersed in discovery and invention, and challenge and critique are core to both, too.

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 1, art-science collaborations have____
options: A) caught the attention of critics.
questions.explanation: 第 31 题是细节题，正确答案 B）received favorable responses. 定位句在第 1 段：启发性强、富有挑战、引人思考、有趣。这些是《自然》杂志读者在一系列关于艺术家与研究者合作的文章中用来描述其艺-科合作体验的一些词。在约 350 位回应配套民调的人里，近 40% 表示自己曾与艺术家合作；几乎所有人都表示未来愿意尝试合作。正确项与原文构成同义替换（Enlightening, challenging, stimulating, fun ↔ favorable responses；almost all said they would consider doing so in future ↔ received favorable responses）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、C 项属无中生有、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: The reworked version of The Four Seasons is mentioned to show that____
options: A) art can offer audiences easy access to science.
B) science can help with the expression of emotions.
C) public participation in science has a promising future.
D) art is effective in facilitating scientific innovations.
questions.explanation: 第 32 题是例证目的题，正确答案 A）art can offer audiences easy access to science. 定位句在第 3 段：上个月，悉尼交响乐团演奏了维瓦尔第《四季》的改编版，这是艺术家和科学家共同震撼舞台的一个例子。他们把莫纳什大学气候变化传播研究中心提供的最新各季气候预测数据注入这部 300 年前的乐谱，重新构想了它。此次演出是 11 月格拉斯哥联合国气候变化大会前的一次极具创意的行动号召。正确项与原文构成同义替换（Artists help scientists reach a broader audience ↔ art can offer audiences easy access to science；make emotional connections that enhance learning ↔ easy access to science；injecting the latest climate prediction data ↔ art ... access to science）。其余三项中，B 项属与原文相反、C 项属过度推断、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: Some artists seem to worry about in the art-science partnership____
options: A) their role may be underestimated.
B) their reputation may be impaired.
C) their creativity may be inhibited.
D) their work may be misguided.
questions.explanation: 第 33 题是细节题，正确答案 A）their role may be underestimated. 定位句在第 4 段：但真正的合作关系必须是双向的。回应《自然》民调的艺术家少于科学家；不过，一些受访者指出，艺术家不只是协助科学家完成传播任务。他们的作品也不应仅被当作研究对象。正确项与原文构成同义替换（artists do not simply assist scientists with their communication requirements ↔ their role may be underestimated；Nor should their work be considered only as an object of study ↔ their role may be underestimated）。其余三项中，B 项属无中生有、C 项属无中生有、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: What does the author say about CAYS?
options: A) It was headed alternately by artists and scientists.
B) It exemplified valuable art-science alliances.
C) Its projects aimed at advancing visual studies.
D) Its founders sought to raise the status of artists.
questions.explanation: 第 34 题是细节题，正确答案 B）It exemplified valuable art-science alliances. 定位句在第 5 段：半个多世纪前，麻省理工学院创办了"先进视觉研究中心"（CAVS），以探索技术在文化中的角色。创办者刻意把项目聚焦在"光"上——所以名字里有"视觉研究"。光是艺术家和科学家都感兴趣的事物，因此能成为他们合作的基础。正确项与原文构成同义替换（Light was something that both artists and scientists had an interest in, and therefore could form the basis of collaboration ↔ It exemplified valuable art-science alliances；looking to a time when leading researchers could also be artists, writers and poets, and vice versa ↔ valuable art-science alliances）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、C 项属偷换概念、D 项属过度推断，均可排除。

questions.stem: In the last paragraph, the author holds that art-science collaborations ____
options: A) are likely to go beyond public expectations.
C) should do more than communicating science.
D) are becoming more popular than before.
questions.explanation: 第 35 题是主旨题，正确答案 C）should do more than communicating science. 该题需通观全文作答。正确项与原文构成同义替换（The reach of art-science tie-ups needs to go beyond the necessary purpose of research communication ↔ should do more than communicating science；participants must not fall into the trap of stereotyping each other ↔ should do more than communicating science）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、B 项属与原文相反、D 项属答非所问，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: Enlightening, challenging, stimulating, fun. These were some of the words that Nature readers used to describe their experience of art-science collaborations in a series of articles on partnerships between artists and researchers. Nearly 40% of the roughly 350 people who responded to an accompanying poll said they had collaborated with artists; and almost all said they would consider doing so in future.
paragraphs.zh: 启迪人心、富有挑战、激发灵感、趣味盎然。这些是Nature读者在一系列关于艺术家与研究人员合作的文章中用来描述他们艺术-科学合作体验的词汇。在随附调查中,大约350名受访者中近40%的人表示他们曾与艺术家合作;几乎所有人都表示未来会考虑这样做。

paragraphs.en: Such an encouraging result is not surprising. Scientists are increasingly seeking out visual artists to help them communicate their work to new audiences. "Artists help scientists reach a broader audience and make emotional connections that enhance learning," one respondent said.
paragraphs.zh: 如此令人鼓舞的结果并不令人意外。科学家们越来越多地寻求视觉艺术家帮助他们向新受众传播其工作。一位受访者说:"艺术家帮助科学家触及更广泛的受众,并建立情感联系以增强学习效果。"

paragraphs.en: One example of how artists and scientists have together rocked the scenes came last month when the Sydney Symphony Orchestra performed a reworked version of Antonio Vivaldi's The Four Seasons. They reimagined the 300-year-old score by injecting the latest climate prediction data for each season—provided by Monash University's Climate Change Communication Research Hub. The performance was a creative call to action ahead of November's United Nations Climate Change Conference in Glasgow, UK.
paragraphs.zh: 上个月,艺术家与科学家如何共同震撼舞台的一个例子出现了,当时悉尼交响乐团演奏了Antonio Vivaldi《四季》的改编版本。他们通过注入Monash大学气候变化传播研究中心提供的每个季节的最新气候预测数据,重新构思了这部有300年历史的乐谱。这场演出是在英国格拉斯哥11月联合国气候变化大会之前发出的创意行动号召。

paragraphs.en: But a genuine partnership must be a two-way street. Fewer artists than scientists responded to the Nature poll; however, several respondents noted that artists do not simply assist scientists with their communication requirements. Nor should their work be considered only as an object of study. The alliances are most valuable when scientists and artists have a shared stake in a project, are able to jointly design it and can critique each other's work. Such an approach can both prompt new research as well as result in powerful art.
paragraphs.zh: 但真正的合作伙伴关系必须是双向的。参与Nature调查的艺术家少于科学家;然而,几位受访者指出,艺术家不仅仅是协助科学家完成其传播需求。他们的作品也不应仅被视为研究对象。当科学家和艺术家在项目中拥有共同利益、能够共同设计项目并能够批评彼此的工作时,这种联盟最有价值。这种方法既可以激发新的研究,也可以产生有力的艺术作品。

paragraphs.en: More than half a century ago, the Massachusetts Institute of Technology opened its Center for Advanced Visual Studies (CAVS) to explore the role of technology in culture. The founders deliberately focused their projects around light—hence the "visual studies" in the name. Light was something that both artists and scientists had an interest in, and therefore could form the basis of collaboration. As science and technology progressed, and divided into more sub-disciplines, the centre was simultaneously looking to a time when leading researchers could also be artists, writers and poets, and vice versa.
paragraphs.zh: 半个多世纪前,Massachusetts Institute of Technology开设了其高级视觉研究中心(CAVS),以探索技术在文化中的作用。创始人有意将他们的项目聚焦于光——因此名称中有"视觉研究"。光是艺术家和科学家都感兴趣的东西,因此可以构成合作的基础。随着科学技术的进步并细分为更多子学科,该中心同时展望着这样一个时代:顶尖研究人员也可以是艺术家、作家和诗人,反之亦然。

paragraphs.en: Nature's poll findings suggest that this trend is as strong as ever, but, to make a collaboration work, both sides need to invest time, and embrace surprise and challenge. The reach of art-science tie-ups needs to go beyond the necessary purpose of research communication, and participants must not fall into the trap of stereotyping each other. Artists and scientists alike are immersed in discovery and invention, and challenge and critique are core to both, too.
paragraphs.zh: Nature的调查结果表明,这一趋势一如既往地强劲,但要使合作成功,双方都需要投入时间,并接受意外和挑战。艺术-科学合作的范围需要超越研究传播的必要目的,参与者不能陷入相互刻板印象的陷阱。艺术家和科学家都沉浸在发现和发明中,挑战和批判也是两者的核心。

reading.title: Text 4
reading.passage: The personal grievance provisions of New Zealand's Employment Relations Act 2000 (ERA) prevent an employer from firing an employee without good cause. Instead, dismissals must be justified. Employers must both show cause and act in a procedurally fair way. Personal grievance procedures were designed to guard the jobs of ordinary workers from "unjustified dismissals". The premise was that the common law of contract lacked sufficient safeguards for workers against arbitrary conduct by management. Long gone are the days when a boss could simply give an employee contractual notice. But these provisions create difficulties for businesses when applied to highly paid managers and executives. As countless boards and business owners will attest, constraining firms from firing poorly performing, high-earning managers is a handbrake on boosting productivity and overall performance. The difference between C-grade and A-grade managers may very well be the difference between business success or failure. Between preserving the jobs of ordinary workers or losing them. Yet mediocrity is no longer enough to justify a dismissal. Consequently—and paradoxically—laws introduced to protect the jobs of ordinary workers may be placing those jobs at risk. If not placing jobs at risk, to the extent employment protection laws constrain business owners from dismissing under-performing managers, those laws act as a constraint on firm productivity and therefore on workers' wages. Indeed, in "An International Perspective on New Zealand's Productivity Paradox" (2014), the Productivity Commission singled out the low quality of managerial capabilities as a cause of the country's poor productivity growth record. Nor are highly paid managers themselves immune from the harm caused by the ERA'S unjustified dismissal procedures. Because employment protection laws make it costlier to fire an employee, employers are more cautious about hiring new staff. This makes it harder for the marginal manager to gain employment. And firms pay staff less because firms carry the burden of the employment arrangement going wrong. Society also suffers from excessive employment protections. Stringent job dismissal regulations adversely affect productivity growth and hamper both prosperity and overall well-being. Across the Tasman Sea, Australia deals with the unjustified dismissal paradox by excluding employees earning above a specified "high-income threshold" from the protection of its unfair dismissal laws. In New Zealand, a 2016 private members' Bill tried to permit firms and high-income employees to contract out of the unjustified dismissal regime. However, the mechanisms proposed were unwieldy and the Bill was voted down following the change in government later that year.

questions.stem: The personal grievance provisions of the ERA are intended to____
options: C) exempt employers from certain duties.
D) protect the rights of ordinary workers.
questions.explanation: 第 36 题是细节题，正确答案 D）protect the rights of ordinary workers. 定位句在第 2 段：人事申诉程序的设立目的，是保护普通工人的岗位免遭「不公正解雇」。正确项与原文构成同义替换（guard the jobs of ordinary workers ↔ protect the rights of ordinary workers；ordinary workers ↔ ordinary workers）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属偷换概念、C 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: It can be learned from Paragraph 3 that the provisions may____
options: C) affect the public image of the firms.
questions.explanation: 第 37 题是推断题，正确答案 A）hinder business development. 定位句在第 3 段：约束企业解雇业绩差、薪资高的管理者，是阻碍生产率与整体绩效提升的手刹。正确项与原文构成同义替换（a handbrake on boosting productivity and overall performance ↔ hinder business development；create difficulties for businesses ↔ hinder business development）。其余三项中，B 项属张冠李戴、C 项属无中生有、D 项属过度推断，均可排除。

questions.stem: Which of the following measures would the Productivity Commission support?
options: C) Limiting the powers of business owners.
questions.explanation: 第 38 题是推断题，正确答案 D）Dismissing poorly performing managers. 定位句在第 5 段：生产率委员会单独点名「管理能力低下」是新西兰生产率增长记录差的一大成因。正确项与原文构成同义替换（the low quality of managerial capabilities ↔ Dismissing poorly performing managers；as a cause of the country's poor productivity growth record ↔ Dismissing poorly performing managers）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属与原文相反、C 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: What might be an effect of ERA's unjustified dismissal procedures?
options: A) Highly paid managers lose their jobs.
B) Employees suffer from salary cuts.
C) Society sees a rise in overall well-being.
D) Employers need to hire new staff.
questions.explanation: 第 39 题是细节题，正确答案 B）Employees suffer from salary cuts. 定位句在第 5 段：即便不至于把岗位置于风险，只要用工保护法约束了企业主解雇业绩差的管理者，这些法律就成了企业生产率的束缚，进而压低了工人的工资。正确项与原文构成同义替换（therefore on workers' wages ↔ Employees suffer from salary cuts；firms pay staff less ↔ Employees suffer from salary cuts）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、C 项属与原文相反、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: It can be inferred that the "high-income threshold" in Australia____
options: C) is beneficial to business owners.
D) is difficult to put into practice
questions.explanation: 第 40 题是推断题，正确答案 C）is beneficial to business owners. 定位句在第 8 段：澳大利亚处理这一不公正解雇悖论的办法，是把收入高于特定「高收入门槛」的雇员排除在不公平解雇法的保护范围之外。正确项与原文构成同义替换（excluding employees earning above a specified "high-income threshold" from the protection of its unfair dismissal laws ↔ is beneficial to business owners；constraining firms from firing poorly performing, high-earning managers is a handbrake on boosting productivity and overall performance ↔ is beneficial to business owners）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属张冠李戴、D 项属张冠李戴，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: The personal grievance provisions of New Zealand's Employment Relations Act 2000 (ERA) prevent an employer from firing an employee without good cause. Instead, dismissals must be justified. Employers must both show cause and act in a procedurally fair way.
paragraphs.zh: 新西兰《2000年雇佣关系法》(ERA)的个人申诉条款禁止雇主无正当理由解雇员工。相反,解雇必须是正当的。雇主必须既要说明理由,又要以程序公正的方式行事。

paragraphs.en: Personal grievance procedures were designed to guard the jobs of ordinary workers from "unjustified dismissals". The premise was that the common law of contract lacked sufficient safeguards for workers against arbitrary conduct by management. Long gone are the days when a boss could simply give an employee contractual notice.
paragraphs.zh: 个人申诉程序旨在保护普通工人的工作免受"不正当解雇"的影响。其前提是合同普通法对工人缺乏足够的保障措施以防范管理层的武断行为。雇主只需给员工合同通知就能解雇的日子早已一去不复返。

paragraphs.en: But these provisions create difficulties for businesses when applied to highly paid managers and executives. As countless boards and business owners will attest, constraining firms from firing poorly performing, high-earning managers is a handbrake on boosting productivity and overall performance. The difference between C-grade and A-grade managers may very well be the difference between business success or failure. Between preserving the jobs of ordinary workers or losing them. Yet mediocrity is no longer enough to justify a dismissal.
paragraphs.zh: 但是,当这些条款适用于高薪经理和高管时,会给企业带来困难。正如无数董事会和企业主所证实的那样,限制公司解雇表现不佳、收入高的经理,是提高生产率和整体业绩的障碍。C级经理和A级经理之间的差异很可能就是企业成功或失败的差异。是保住普通工人的工作还是失去他们的工作。然而,平庸已不再足以成为解雇的正当理由。

paragraphs.en: Consequently—and paradoxically—laws introduced to protect the jobs of ordinary workers may be placing those jobs at risk.
paragraphs.zh: 因此——也很矛盾的是——为保护普通工人工作而引入的法律可能正在使这些工作面临风险。

paragraphs.en: If not placing jobs at risk, to the extent employment protection laws constrain business owners from dismissing under-performing managers, those laws act as a constraint on firm productivity and therefore on workers' wages. Indeed, in "An International Perspective on New Zealand's Productivity Paradox" (2014), the Productivity Commission singled out the low quality of managerial capabilities as a cause of the country's poor productivity growth record.
paragraphs.zh: 如果不是使工作面临风险,那么在雇佣保护法限制企业主解雇表现不佳的经理的程度上,这些法律就成为对企业生产率的约束,因而也是对工人工资的约束。事实上,在《新西兰生产率悖论的国际视角》(2014)中,生产率委员会特别指出管理能力的低质量是该国生产率增长记录不佳的一个原因。

paragraphs.en: Nor are highly paid managers themselves immune from the harm caused by the ERA'S unjustified dismissal procedures. Because employment protection laws make it costlier to fire an employee, employers are more cautious about hiring new staff. This makes it harder for the marginal manager to gain employment. And firms pay staff less because firms carry the burden of the employment arrangement going wrong.
paragraphs.zh: 高薪经理本身也不能免受ERA不正当解雇程序所造成的损害。由于雇佣保护法使解雇员工的成本更高,雇主在雇用新员工时更加谨慎。这使得边际经理更难获得就业。而且企业支付给员工的薪酬更少,因为企业承担着雇佣安排出错的负担。

paragraphs.en: Society also suffers from excessive employment protections. Stringent job dismissal regulations adversely affect productivity growth and hamper both prosperity and overall well-being.
paragraphs.zh: 社会也受到过度雇佣保护的损害。严格的工作解雇法规对生产率增长产生不利影响,并阻碍繁荣和整体福祉。

paragraphs.en: Across the Tasman Sea, Australia deals with the unjustified dismissal paradox by excluding employees earning above a specified "high-income threshold" from the protection of its unfair dismissal laws. In New Zealand, a 2016 private members' Bill tried to permit firms and high-income employees to contract out of the unjustified dismissal regime. However, the mechanisms proposed were unwieldy and the Bill was voted down following the change in government later that year.
paragraphs.zh: 在塔斯曼海对岸,澳大利亚通过将收入超过特定"高收入门槛"的员工排除在其不公平解雇法的保护之外,来应对不正当解雇悖论。在新西兰,2016年一项议员个人提案试图允许企业和高收入员工退出不正当解雇制度。然而,提议的机制繁琐不堪,该法案在当年晚些时候政府更迭后被否决。

blanks.explanation: 第 1 空正确答案 A）coined。主语是 the term（一个新名称）。其余三项：B）discovered 义偏：术语是被造不是被发现、C）collected 搭配不当：术语不被「收集」、D）issued 义偏：issue 指发布文件/命令，均可排除。
第 2 空正确答案 C）compared。compare A to B = 把A比作B。其余三项：A）attributed 义偏：attribute to 是「归因于」、B）directed 义偏：direct to 是「指向/引导」、D）confined 义偏：confine to 是「限制在」，均可排除。
第 3 空正确答案 D）Though。主句有 nonetheless，标志让步转折。其余三项：A）Unless 逻辑反：unless 表「除非」否定条件、B）When 逻辑弱：when 只表时间，无让步味、C）Once 逻辑偏：once 表「一旦」条件，均可排除。
第 4 空正确答案 C）hinted at。全文立场：植物意识只是「迹象」非定论。其余三项：A）coped with 义偏：cope with 是「应对/处理」、B）consisted of 义偏：consist of 是「由…组成」、D）extended to 义偏：extend to 是「延伸到/扩展至」，均可排除。
第 5 空正确答案 D）differs。But + 强调差异的语境。其余三项：A）suffers 义偏：suffer from 是「受…之苦」、B）benefits 义偏：benefit from 是「受益于」、C）develops 搭配不当：develop 一般不接 from 表此意，均可排除。
第 6 空正确答案 B）evidence。表语 inconclusive 指向「证据」。其余三项：A）acceptance 义偏：acceptance 是「接受」、C）cultivation 干扰：cultivation 蹭 plant 字面、D）creation 义偏：creation 是「创造」，均可排除。
第 7 空正确答案 C）argued。下文 claimed 同义复现。其余三项：A）doubted 方向反：doubt 是「怀疑」、B）denied 方向反：deny 是「否认」、D）requested 搭配/义偏：request 表「请求」，均可排除。
第 8 空正确答案 B）forming。前因后果：互动从而「构成」一个系统。其余三项：A）adapting 义偏：adapt 是「适应/改编」、C）repairing 义偏：repair 是「修复」、D）testing 义偏：test 是「测试」，均可排除。
第 9 空正确答案 A）analogous。全文主线是「植物与动物作类比」。其余三项：B）essential 义偏：essential to 是「对…必不可少」、C）suitable 义偏：suitable to/for 是「适合」、D）sensitive 义偏：sensitive to 是「对…敏感」，均可排除。
第 10 空正确答案 D）even。本句主张比上句更夸张，构成递进。其余三项：A）just 语气反：just 表「仅仅」，削弱、B）ever 用法偏：ever 多用于疑问/否定/比较、C）still 义偏：still 表「仍然」，无递进义，均可排除。
第 11 空正确答案 C）perspective。This 回指第3段那套「类比看法」。其余三项：A）restriction 义偏：restriction 是「限制」、B）experiment 义偏：前文是看法不是实验、D）demand 义偏：demand 是「要求/需求」，均可排除。
第 12 空正确答案 B）reducing。前句 simplify 同义提示。其余三项：A）attaching 义偏：attach to 是「把…附在…上」、C）returning 义偏：return to 是「返回/恢复」、D）exposing 义偏：expose to 是「使暴露于」，均可排除。
第 13 空正确答案 A）However。上句让步、本句转折拆穿。其余三项：B）Moreover 逻辑反：Moreover 表递进补充、C）Therefore 逻辑反：Therefore 表因果结论、D）Otherwise 逻辑反：Otherwise 表「否则」，均可排除。
第 14 空正确答案 C）superficially。only + 下文「不止是电活动」共指「表面」。其余三项：A）temporarily 义偏：temporarily 是「暂时地」、B）literally 义反：literally 是「确实/字面上」，强化、D）imaginarily 义偏：imaginarily 是「想象地」，均可排除。
第 15 空正确答案 B）level。of complexity and capacity 指向「程度」。其余三项：A）list 搭配不当：list of 是「清单」、C）label 义偏：label 是「标签」、D）load 义偏：load 是「负荷/装载量」，均可排除。
第 16 空正确答案 D）added。Taiz 在前文基础上再补一句。其余三项：A）recalled 义偏：recall 是「回忆」、B）agreed 义偏：agree 需有被附和的对象、C）questioned 语气反：question 是「质疑」，均可排除。
第 17 空正确答案 A）chances。Since 因果 + zero 指向「可能性」。其余三项：B）risks 色彩偏：risk 是「风险」含负面、C）excuses 义偏：excuse 是「借口」、D）assumptions 搭配不当：assumption 不与 zero 搭，均可排除。
第 18 空正确答案 A）danger。下文 threat、feel pain 同指「危险」。其余三项：B）failure 义偏：failure 是「失败」、C）warning 义偏：warning 是「警告」、D）control 义偏：control 是「控制」，均可排除。
第 19 空正确答案 D）recognizes。并列 can feel pain 提示「感知」。其余三项：A）represents 义偏：represent 是「代表/象征」、B）includes 义偏：include 是「包含」、C）reveals 义偏：reveal 是「揭示/显露」，均可排除。
第 20 空正确答案 B）poor。前文 can't run away → 该策略没用、糟糕。其余三项：A）humble 义偏：humble 是「谦逊/卑微」、C）practical 色彩反：practical 是「实用的」褒义、D）easy 义偏：easy 是「容易的」，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: The idea that plants have some degree of consciousness first took root in the early 2000s; the term "plant neurobiology" was [1] around the notion that some aspects of plant behavior could be [2] to intelligence in animals. [3] plants lack brains, the firing of electrical signals in their stems and leaves nonetheless triggered responses that [4] consciousness, researchers previously reported.
paragraphs.zh: 植物具有某种程度意识的观点最早萌芽于21世纪初;"植物神经生物学"这一术语是围绕植物行为的某些方面可与动物智能相比较这一概念而创造的。研究人员此前报告称,尽管植物缺乏大脑,但其茎和叶中电信号的发射仍然引发了暗示意识存在的反应。

paragraphs.en: But such an idea is untrue, according to a new opinion article. Plant biology is complex and fascinating, but it [5] so greatly from that of animals that so-called [6] of plants' intelligence is inconclusive, the authors wrote.
paragraphs.zh: 但根据一篇新的观点文章,这种观点是不正确的。作者写道,植物生物学是复杂而迷人的,但它与动物生物学差异如此之大,以至于所谓植物智能的证据是不确定的。

paragraphs.en: Beginning in 2006, some scientists have [7] that plants possess neuron-like cells that interact with hormones and neurotransmitters, [8] "a plant nervous system, [9] to that in animals," said lead study author Lincoln Taiz. "They [10] claimed that plants have 'brain-like command centers' at their root tips."
paragraphs.zh: 该研究的第一作者Lincoln Taiz说,从2006年开始,一些科学家认为植物拥有类似神经元的细胞,这些细胞与激素和神经递质相互作用,形成"类似于动物的植物神经系统"。"他们甚至声称植物在其根尖有'类似大脑的指挥中心'。"

paragraphs.en: This [11] makes sense if you simplify the workings of a complex brain, [12] it to an array of electrical pulses; cells in plants also communicate through electrical signals. [13] , the signaling in a plant is only [14] similar to the firing in a complex animal brain, which is more than "a mass of cells that communicate by electricity," Taiz said.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你简化复杂大脑的运作方式,将其简化为一系列电脉冲,这种观点就说得通;植物细胞也通过电信号进行交流。然而,Taiz说,植物中的信号传导只是在表面上类似于复杂动物大脑中的放电,而动物大脑不仅仅是"一团通过电流交流的细胞"。

paragraphs.en: "For consciousness to evolve, a brain with a threshold [15] of complexity and capacity is required," he [16] . "Since plants don't have nervous systems, the [17] that they have consciousness are effectively zero."
paragraphs.zh: 他补充说:"意识要进化,需要具有一定复杂性和容量阈值水平的大脑。由于植物没有神经系统,它们拥有意识的可能性实际上为零。"

paragraphs.en: And what's so great about consciousness, anyway? Plants can't run away from [18] , so investing energy in a body system which [19] a threat and can feel pain would be a very [20] evolutionary strategy, according to the article.
paragraphs.zh: 而且,意识究竟有什么了不起的呢?根据这篇文章,植物无法逃离危险,因此将能量投资于一个能识别威胁并能感受疼痛的身体系统,将是一个非常糟糕的进化策略。

reading.title: Text 1
reading.passage: On a recent sunny day, 13,000 chickens roam over Larry Brown's 40 windswept acres in Shiner, Texas. Some rest in the shade of a parked car. Others drink water with the cows. This all seems random, but it's by design, part of what the $6.1 billion U.S. egg industry bets will be its next big thing: climate-friendly eggs. These eggs, which are making their debut now on shelves for as much as $8 a dozen, are still labeled organic and animal-friendly, but they're also from birds that live on farms using regenerative agriculture—special techniques to cultivate rich soils that can trap greenhouse gases. Such eggs could be marketed as helping to fight climate change. "I'm excited about our progress," says Brown, who harvests eggs for Denver-based Nest Fresh Eggs and is adding more cover crops that draw worms and crickets for the chickens to eat. The birds' waste then fertilizes fields. Such improvements "allow our hens to forage for higher-quality natural feed that will be good for the land, the hens, and the eggs that we supply to our customers." The egg industry's push is the first major test of whether animal products from regenerative farms can become the next premium offering. In barely more than a decade, organic eggs went from being dismissed as a niche product in natural foods stores to being sold at Walmart. More recently there were similar doubts about probiotics and plant-based meats, but both have exploded into major supermarket categories. If the sustainable-egg rollout is successful, it could open the floodgates for regenerative beef, broccoli, and beyond. Regenerative products could be a hard sell, because the concept is tough to define quickly, says Julie Stanton, associate professor of agricultural economics at Pennsylvania State University Brandywine. Such farming also brings minimal, if any, improvement to the food products (though some producers say their eggs have more protein). The industry is betting that the same consumers paying more for premium attributes such as free-range, non-GMO, and pasture-raised eggs will embrace sustainability. Surveys show that younger generations are more concerned about climate change, and some of the success of plant-based meat can be chalked up to shoppers wanting to signal their desire to protect the environment. Young adults "really care about the planet," says John Brunnquell, president of Egg Innovations. "They are absolutely altering the food chain beyond what I think even they understand what they're doing."

questions.stem: The climate-friendly eggs are produced____
options: A) at a considerably low cost.
B) at the demand of regular shoppers.
C) as a replacement for organic eggs.
questions.explanation: 第 21 题是细节题，正确答案 D）on specially designed farms. 定位句在第 2 段：这些鸡蛋如今正以高达每打 8 美元的价格首次上架，它们仍贴着有机和善待动物的标签，但同时来自饲养在使用「再生农业」——一种通过特殊技术蓄养富含温室气体的土壤的农场里的鸡。正确项与原文构成同义替换（from birds that live on farms using regenerative agriculture—special techniques to cultivate rich soils ↔ on specially designed farms）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属偷换概念、C 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: Larry Brown is excited about his progress in____
options: A) reducing the damage of worms.
B) accelerating the disposal of waste.
D) attracting customers to his products.
questions.explanation: 第 22 题是细节题，正确答案 C）creating a sustainable system. 定位句在第 3 段：「我对我们取得的进展感到兴奋，」Brown 说道——他为总部位于丹佛的 Nest Fresh Eggs 收蛋，正在种更多吸引蠕虫和蟋蟀供鸡食用的覆盖作物。鸡的粪便再肥沃田地。这些改进「让我们的母鸡能觅食更高质量的天然饲料，这有益于土地、母鸡，以及我们供给客户的鸡蛋。」正确项与原文构成同义替换（cover crops that draw worms and crickets for the chickens to eat. The birds' waste then fertilizes fields ↔ creating a sustainable system；good for the land, the hens, and the eggs that we supply to our customers ↔ sustainable）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属无中生有、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: The example of organic eggs is used in Paragraph 4 to suggest____
options: A) the doubts over natural feeds.
B) the setbacks in the egg industry.
C) the potential of regenerative products.
D) the promotional success of supermarkets.
questions.explanation: 第 23 题是例证目的题，正确答案 C）the potential of regenerative products. 定位句在第 4 段：蛋业的此次推动，是检验「再生农场动物产品能否成为下一类高端品」的首次重大试金石。短短十多年里，有机蛋从被视作天然食品店里的小众品发展到沃尔玛上架。最近益生菌和植物肉也曾遭遇类似怀疑，如今两者都已变成超市主要品类。如果可持续蛋的推广成功，将为再生牛肉、西兰花等打开闸门。正确项与原文构成同义替换（If the sustainable-egg rollout is successful, it could open the floodgates for regenerative beef, broccoli, and beyond ↔ the potential of regenerative products；regenerative beef, broccoli, and beyond ↔ regenerative products）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、B 项属与原文相反、D 项属张冠李戴，均可排除。

questions.stem: It can be learned from the last paragraph that young people____
options: A) are reluctant to change their diet.
B) are likely to buy climate-friendly eggs.
C) are curious about new food.
D) are amazed at agriculture advances.
questions.explanation: 第 24 题是推断题，正确答案 B）are likely to buy climate-friendly eggs. 定位句在第 6 段：业界押注：那些已经为散养、非转基因、牧场放养等高端属性多付钱的消费者，也会拥抱可持续性。调查显示年轻一代更关注气候变化，植物肉的部分成功可归因于消费者想表达保护环境的意愿。Brunnquell 说，年轻人「真心关心地球」。正确项与原文构成同义替换（younger generations are more concerned about climate change ↔ are likely to buy climate-friendly eggs；the same consumers paying more for premium attributes...will embrace sustainability ↔ climate-friendly eggs）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、C 项属无中生有、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: John Brunnquell would disagree with Julie Stanton over regenerative products'____
questions.explanation: 第 25 题是细节题，正确答案 A）market prospects. 定位句在第 5 段：宾州州立大学布兰迪万分校农业经济学副教授 Julie Stanton 说，再生类产品可能很难卖，因为「再生」这个概念很难一句话讲清楚。这种农法对食品本身的改善也微乎其微，甚至几乎没有（尽管有些生产者说他们的蛋蛋白质更多）。正确项与原文构成同义替换（Regenerative products could be a hard sell ↔ market prospects；The industry is betting that the same consumers paying more for premium attributes...will embrace sustainability ↔ market prospects）。其余三项中，B 项属答非所问、C 项属答非所问、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

reading.title: Text 2
reading.passage: More Americans are opting to work well into retirement, a growing trend that threatens to upend the old workforce model. One in three Americans who are at least 40 have or plan to have a job in retirement to prepare for a longer life, according to a survey conducted by Harris Poll for TD Ameritrade. Even more surprising is that more than half of "unretirees"—those who plan to work in retirement or went back to work after retiring—said they would be employed in their later years even if they had enough money to settle down, the survey showed. Financial needs aren't the only culprit for the "unretirement" trend. Other reasons, according to the study, include personal fulfillment such as staying mentally fit, preventing boredom or avoiding depression. About 72% of "unretiree" respondents said that they would return to work once retired to keep mentally fit while 59% said it would be tied to making ends meet. "The concept of retirement is evolving," said Christine Russell, senior manager of retirement at TD Ameritrade. "It's not just about finances. The value of work is also driving folks to continue working past retirement." One reason for the change in retirement patterns: Americans are living longer. The share of the population 65 and older was 16% in 2018, up 32% from the prior year, according to the U.S. Census Bureau. That's also up 30.2% since 2010. Older Americans are also the fastest-growing segment of the US workforce, and boomers are expected to live longer than previous generations. The percentage of retirement-age people in the labor force has doubled over the past three decades. About 20% of people 65 and older were in the workforce in February, up from an all-time low of 10% in January 1985, according to money manager United Income. Because of longer life spans, Americans are also boosting their savings to preserve their nest eggs, the TD Ameritrade study showed, which surveyed 2000 adults between 40 and 79. Six in 10 "unretirees" are increasing their savings in anticipation of a longer life, according to the survey. Among the most popular ways they are doing this, the company said, is by reducing their overall expenses, securing life insurance or maximizing their contributions to retirement accounts. Unfortunately, many people who are opting to work in retirement are preparing to do so because they are worried about making ends meet in their later years, said Brent Weiss, a co-founder at Baltimore-based financial-planning firm Facet Wealth. He suggested that preretirees should speak with a financial adviser to set long-term financial goals. "The most challenging moments in life are getting married, starting a family and ultimately retiring," Weiss said. "It's not just a financial decision, but an emotional one. Many people believe they can't retire."

questions.stem: The survey conducted by Harris Poll indicates that____
options: A) over half of the retirees are physically fit for work.
B) the old workforce is as active as the younger one.
C) one in three Americans enjoy earlier retirement.
D) more Americans are willing to work in retirement.
questions.explanation: 第 26 题是细节题，正确答案 D）more Americans are willing to work in retirement. 定位句在第 2 段：据 Harris Poll 为 TD Ameritrade 做的一项调查，40 岁以上美国人中每三人就有一人已有或计划在退休后工作，以应对更长寿命；更令人惊讶的是，超过半数的"unretirees"（即计划退休后继续工作或退休后又回到工作岗位者）表示，即便钱够了也仍愿在晚年继续就业。正确项与原文构成同义替换（One in three Americans who are at least 40 have or plan to have a job in retirement ↔ more Americans are willing to work in retirement；more than half of "unretirees"…said they would be employed in their later years even if they had enough money to settle down ↔ willing to work in retirement）。其余三项中，A 项属偷换概念、B 项属无中生有、C 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

questions.stem: It can be inferred from Paragraph 3 that Americans tend to think that____
options: A) retirement may cause problems for them.
B) boredom can be relieved after retirement.
C) the mental health of retirees is overlooked.
questions.explanation: 第 27 题是推断题，正确答案 A）retirement may cause problems for them. 定位句在第 3 段：财务需要并非"unretirement"现象的唯一原因。据该研究，其他原因还包括获得个人成就感，比如保持心智健康、防止无聊或避免抑郁。正确项与原文构成同义替换（staying mentally fit, preventing boredom or avoiding depression ↔ retirement may cause problems for them）。其余三项中，B 项属与原文相反、C 项属无中生有、D 项属答非所问，均可排除。

questions.stem: Retirement patterns are changing partly due to____
questions.explanation: 第 28 题是细节题，正确答案 C）longer life expectancy. 定位句在第 5 段：退休模式改变的一个原因：美国人活得更久。正确项与原文构成同义替换（Americans are living longer. ↔ longer life expectancy）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属偷换概念、D 项属答非所问，均可排除。

questions.stem: Many "unretirees" are increasing their savings by____
questions.explanation: 第 29 题是细节题，正确答案 D）spending less. 定位句在第 6 段：据该公司称，他们这么做（增加储蓄）最常见的方式包括：削减总体开支、购买寿险或将退休账户缴款最大化。正确项与原文构成同义替换（reducing their overall expenses ↔ spending less）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属无中生有、C 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: With regard to retirement, Brent Weiss thinks that many people are____
questions.explanation: 第 30 题是细节题，正确答案 A）unprepared. 定位句在第 7 段：Brent Weiss（巴尔的摩 Facet Wealth 理财公司联合创始人）说，遗憾的是，许多选择退休后继续工作的人之所以这样准备，是因为他们担心晚年入不敷出。他建议未退休者与理财顾问沟通以设定长期财务目标。正确项与原文构成同义替换（worried about making ends meet in their later years ↔ unprepared；preretirees should speak with a financial adviser to set long-term financial goals ↔ unprepared；Many people believe they can't retire. ↔ unprepared）。其余三项中，B 项属与原文相反、C 项属过度推断、D 项属与原文相反，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: More Americans are opting to work well into retirement, a growing trend that threatens to upend the old workforce model.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的美国人选择工作到退休后很久，这一日益增长的趋势可能会颠覆旧有的劳动力模式。

paragraphs.en: One in three Americans who are at least 40 have or plan to have a job in retirement to prepare for a longer life, according to a survey conducted by Harris Poll for TD Ameritrade. Even more surprising is that more than half of "unretirees"—those who plan to work in retirement or went back to work after retiring—said they would be employed in their later years even if they had enough money to settle down, the survey showed.
paragraphs.zh: 根据Harris Poll为TD Ameritrade进行的一项调查，年龄至少40岁的美国人中有三分之一已经或计划在退休后找一份工作，为更长的寿命做准备。更令人惊讶的是，调查显示，超过半数的"不退休者"——那些计划在退休后工作或退休后重返工作岗位的人——表示即使有足够的钱安顿下来,他们也会在晚年继续工作。

paragraphs.en: Financial needs aren't the only culprit for the "unretirement" trend. Other reasons, according to the study, include personal fulfillment such as staying mentally fit, preventing boredom or avoiding depression. About 72% of "unretiree" respondents said that they would return to work once retired to keep mentally fit while 59% said it would be tied to making ends meet.
paragraphs.zh: 经济需求并非"不退休"趋势的唯一原因。根据该研究，其他原因包括个人成就感,如保持精神健康、防止无聊或避免抑郁。约72%的"不退休者"受访者表示,他们会在退休后重返工作以保持精神健康,而59%的人表示这与维持生计有关。

paragraphs.en: "The concept of retirement is evolving," said Christine Russell, senior manager of retirement at TD Ameritrade. "It's not just about finances. The value of work is also driving folks to continue working past retirement."
paragraphs.zh: TD Ameritrade退休业务高级经理Christine Russell表示:"退休的概念正在演变。这不仅仅关乎财务。工作的价值也在驱使人们在退休后继续工作。"

paragraphs.en: One reason for the change in retirement patterns: Americans are living longer. The share of the population 65 and older was 16% in 2018, up 32% from the prior year, according to the U.S. Census Bureau. That's also up 30.2% since 2010. Older Americans are also the fastest-growing segment of the US workforce, and boomers are expected to live longer than previous generations. The percentage of retirement-age people in the labor force has doubled over the past three decades. About 20% of people 65 and older were in the workforce in February, up from an all-time low of 10% in January 1985, according to money manager United Income.
paragraphs.zh: 退休模式改变的一个原因是:美国人的寿命更长了。根据美国人口普查局的数据,2018年65岁及以上人口占总人口的16%,比前一年增长32%。这也比2010年增长了30.2%。老年美国人也是美国劳动力中增长最快的群体,婴儿潮一代预计比前几代人更长寿。过去三十年中,退休年龄人口在劳动力中的比例翻了一番。根据资产管理公司United Income的数据,2月份约有20%的65岁及以上人口在劳动力队伍中,高于1985年1月10%的历史最低水平。

paragraphs.en: Because of longer life spans, Americans are also boosting their savings to preserve their nest eggs, the TD Ameritrade study showed, which surveyed 2000 adults between 40 and 79. Six in 10 "unretirees" are increasing their savings in anticipation of a longer life, according to the survey. Among the most popular ways they are doing this, the company said, is by reducing their overall expenses, securing life insurance or maximizing their contributions to retirement accounts.
paragraphs.zh: TD Ameritrade的研究显示,由于寿命延长,美国人也在增加储蓄以保护他们的养老金,该研究调查了2000名年龄在40至79岁之间的成年人。根据调查,十分之六的"不退休者"正在增加储蓄以应对更长的寿命。该公司表示,他们这样做的最流行方式包括减少总体开支、购买人寿保险或最大化他们对退休账户的缴款。

paragraphs.en: Unfortunately, many people who are opting to work in retirement are preparing to do so because they are worried about making ends meet in their later years, said Brent Weiss, a co-founder at Baltimore-based financial-planning firm Facet Wealth. He suggested that preretirees should speak with a financial adviser to set long-term financial goals.
paragraphs.zh: 位于Baltimore的财务规划公司Facet Wealth的联合创始人Brent Weiss表示,不幸的是,许多选择在退休后工作的人准备这样做是因为他们担心晚年无法维持生计。他建议即将退休的人应该与财务顾问交谈以设定长期财务目标。

paragraphs.en: "The most challenging moments in life are getting married, starting a family and ultimately retiring," Weiss said. "It's not just a financial decision, but an emotional one. Many people believe they can't retire."
paragraphs.zh: Weiss说:"人生中最具挑战性的时刻是结婚、组建家庭以及最终退休。这不仅仅是一个财务决定,而且是一个情感决定。许多人认为他们无法退休。"

reading.title: Text 3
reading.passage: We have all encountered them, in both our personal and professional lives. Think about the times you felt tricked or frustrated by a membership or subscription that had a seamless sign-up process but was later difficult to cancel. Something that should be simple and transparent can be complicated, intentionally or unintentionally, in ways that impair consumer choice. These are examples of dark patterns. First coined in 2010 by user experience expert Harry Brignull, "dark patterns" is a catch-all term for practices that manipulate user interfaces to influence the decision-making ability of users. Brignull identifies 12 types of common dark patterns, ranging from misdirection and hidden costs to "roach motel", where a user experience seems easy and intuitive at the start, but turns difficult when the user tries to get out. In a 2019 study of 53,000 product pages and 11,000 websites, researchers found that about one in 10 employs these design practices. Though widely prevalent, the concept of dark patterns is still not well understood. Business and nonprofit leaders should be aware of dark patterns and try to avoid the gray areas they engender. Where is the line between ethical, persuasive design and dark patterns? Businesses should engage in conversations with IT, compliance, risk, and legal teams to review their privacy policy, and include in the discussion the customer/user experience designers and coders responsible for the company's user interface, as well as the marketers and advertisers responsible for sign-ups, checkout baskets, pricing, and promotions. Any or all these teams can play a role in creating or avoiding "digital deception." Lawmakers and regulators are slowly starting to address the ambiguity around dark patterns, most recently at the state level. In March, the California Attorney General announced the approval of additional regulations under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) that "ensure that consumers will not be confused or misled when seeking to exercise their data privacy rights. The regulations aim to ban dark patterns—this means prohibiting companies from using confusing language or unnecessary steps such as forcing them to click through multiple screens or listen to reasons why they shouldn't opt out." As more states consider promulgating additional regulations, there is a need for greater accountability from within the business community. Dark patterns also can be addressed on a self-regulatory basis, but only if organizations hold themselves accountable, not just to legal requirements but also to industry best practices and standards.

questions.stem: It can be learned from the first two paragraphs that dark patterns____
options: B) leak user information for profit
D) remind users of hidden costs
questions.explanation: 第 31 题是细节题，正确答案 C）undermine users' decision-making 定位句在第 2 段：用户体验专家 Harry Brignull 于 2010 年首创了"黑暗模式"这一统称，用以指代那些操纵用户界面、影响用户决策能力的设计手法。正确项与原文构成同义替换（influence the decision-making ability of users ↔ undermine users' decision-making；manipulate user interfaces ↔ undermine users' decision-making）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属无中生有、D 项属偷换概念，均可排除。

questions.stem: The 2019 study on dark patterns is mentioned to show____
questions.explanation: 第 32 题是例证目的题，正确答案 D）their strong presence 定位句在第 3 段：在一项 2019 年涉及 5.3 万个产品页面和 1.1 万个网站的研究中，研究者发现大约十分之一采用了这类设计手法。尽管广泛流行，黑暗模式这一概念却仍未被充分理解。正确项与原文构成同义替换（widely prevalent ↔ their strong presence；about one in 10 employs these design practices ↔ their strong presence）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属无中生有、C 项属过度推断，均可排除。

questions.stem: To handle digital deception, businesses should____
questions.explanation: 第 33 题是细节题，正确答案 B）talk with relevant teams 定位句在第 4 段：商家应当与 IT、合规、风控和法务团队展开对话以审查隐私政策，并把负责公司用户界面的用户体验设计师与程序员，以及负责注册、结账、定价和促销的营销与广告团队都纳入讨论。正确项与原文构成同义替换（engage in conversations with IT, compliance, risk, and legal teams ↔ talk with relevant teams）。其余三项中，A 项属张冠李戴、C 项属无中生有、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: The additional regulations under the CCPA are intended to____
options: A) guide users through opt-out processes
B) protect consumers from being tricked
C) grant companies data privacy rights
D) restrict access to problematic content
questions.explanation: 第 34 题是细节题，正确答案 B）protect consumers from being tricked 定位句在第 5 段：三月，加州总检察长宣布批准了《加州消费者隐私法案》（CCPA）下的新增条例，旨在"确保消费者在行使数据隐私权时不会被混淆或误导"。正确项与原文构成同义替换（ensure that consumers will not be confused or misled ↔ protect consumers from being tricked）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、C 项属张冠李戴、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: According to the last paragraph, a key to coping with dark patterns is ____
questions.explanation: 第 35 题是细节题，正确答案 B）businesses' self-discipline 定位句在第 6 段：黑暗模式也可以通过自我监管来解决，但前提是组织自我问责——不仅对法律要求，还要对行业最佳实践和标准负责。正确项与原文构成同义替换（organizations hold themselves accountable ↔ businesses' self-discipline；self-regulatory basis ↔ businesses' self-discipline）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、C 项属张冠李戴、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: We have all encountered them, in both our personal and professional lives. Think about the times you felt tricked or frustrated by a membership or subscription that had a seamless sign-up process but was later difficult to cancel. Something that should be simple and transparent can be complicated, intentionally or unintentionally, in ways that impair consumer choice. These are examples of dark patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在个人生活和职业生涯中都遇到过它们。想想那些让你感到被欺骗或沮丧的会员资格或订阅服务，它们注册过程无缝顺畅，但后来却很难取消。本应简单透明的事情却可能被有意或无意地复杂化，从而损害消费者的选择权。这些就是暗黑模式的例子。

paragraphs.en: First coined in 2010 by user experience expert Harry Brignull, "dark patterns" is a catch-all term for practices that manipulate user interfaces to influence the decision-making ability of users. Brignull identifies 12 types of common dark patterns, ranging from misdirection and hidden costs to "roach motel", where a user experience seems easy and intuitive at the start, but turns difficult when the user tries to get out.
paragraphs.zh: 2010年由用户体验专家Harry Brignull首次提出，"暗黑模式"是一个概括性术语，指操纵用户界面以影响用户决策能力的做法。Brignull识别出12种常见的暗黑模式类型，从误导和隐藏成本到"蟑螂旅馆"，即用户体验在开始时看起来简单直观，但当用户试图退出时却变得困难。

paragraphs.en: In a 2019 study of 53,000 product pages and 11,000 websites, researchers found that about one in 10 employs these design practices. Though widely prevalent, the concept of dark patterns is still not well understood. Business and nonprofit leaders should be aware of dark patterns and try to avoid the gray areas they engender.
paragraphs.zh: 在2019年一项对53000个产品页面和11000个网站的研究中，研究人员发现约十分之一采用了这些设计做法。尽管广泛流行，暗黑模式的概念仍未被充分理解。企业和非营利组织领导者应该意识到暗黑模式，并努力避免它们所产生的灰色地带。

paragraphs.en: Where is the line between ethical, persuasive design and dark patterns? Businesses should engage in conversations with IT, compliance, risk, and legal teams to review their privacy policy, and include in the discussion the customer/user experience designers and coders responsible for the company's user interface, as well as the marketers and advertisers responsible for sign-ups, checkout baskets, pricing, and promotions. Any or all these teams can play a role in creating or avoiding "digital deception."
paragraphs.zh: 道德的、具有说服力的设计与暗黑模式之间的界限在哪里?企业应该与IT、合规、风险和法律团队展开对话，审查其隐私政策，并将负责公司用户界面的客户/用户体验设计师和编码人员，以及负责注册、结账篮、定价和促销的营销人员和广告商纳入讨论。这些团队中的任何一个或全部都可能在创造或避免"数字欺骗"中发挥作用。

paragraphs.en: Lawmakers and regulators are slowly starting to address the ambiguity around dark patterns, most recently at the state level. In March, the California Attorney General announced the approval of additional regulations under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) that "ensure that consumers will not be confused or misled when seeking to exercise their data privacy rights. The regulations aim to ban dark patterns—this means prohibiting companies from using confusing language or unnecessary steps such as forcing them to click through multiple screens or listen to reasons why they shouldn't opt out."
paragraphs.zh: 立法者和监管机构正在缓慢开始解决暗黑模式周围的模糊性问题，最近主要在州一级。3月，加州总检察长宣布批准California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA)下的附加法规，"确保消费者在寻求行使其数据隐私权时不会感到困惑或被误导。这些法规旨在禁止暗黑模式——这意味着禁止公司使用令人困惑的语言或不必要的步骤，例如强迫他们点击多个屏幕或听取他们不应该选择退出的理由。"

paragraphs.en: As more states consider promulgating additional regulations, there is a need for greater accountability from within the business community. Dark patterns also can be addressed on a self-regulatory basis, but only if organizations hold themselves accountable, not just to legal requirements but also to industry best practices and standards.
paragraphs.zh: 随着更多州考虑颁布额外的法规，商业界需要更大的问责制。暗黑模式也可以在自律的基础上得到解决，但前提是组织不仅要对法律要求负责，还要对行业最佳实践和标准负责。

reading.title: Text 4
reading.passage: Although ethics classes are common around the world, scientists are unsure if their lessons can actually change behavior; evidence either way is weak, relying on contrived laboratory tests or sometimes unreliable self-reports. But a new study published in Cognition found that, in at least one real-world situation, a single ethics lesson may have had lasting effects. The researchers investigated one class session's impact on eating meat. They chose this particular behavior for three reasons, according to study co-author Eric Schwitzgebel, a philosopher at the University of California, Riverside: students' attitudes on the topic are variable and unstable, behavior is easily measurable, and ethics literature largely agrees that eating less meat is good because it reduces environmental harm and animal suffering. Half of the students in four large philosophy classes read an article on the ethics of factory-farmed meat, optionally watched an 11-minute video on the topic and joined a 50-minute discussion. The other half focused on charitable giving instead. Then, unknown to the students, the researchers studied their anonymized meal-card purchases for that semester—nearly 14,000 receipts for almost 500 students. Schwitzgebel predicted the intervention would have no effect; he had previously found that ethics professors do not differ from other professors on a range of behaviors, including voting rates, blood donation and returning library books. But among student subjects who discussed meat ethics, meal purchases containing meat decreased from 52 to 45 percent—and this effect held steady for the study's duration of several weeks. Purchases from the other group remained at 52 percent. "That's actually a pretty large effect for a pretty small intervention," Schwitzgebel says. Psychologist Nina Strohminger at the University of Pennsylvania, who was not involved in the study, says she wants the effect to be real but cannot rule out some unknown confounding variable. And if real, she notes, it might be reversible by another nudge: "Easy come, easy go." Schwitzgebel suspects the greatest impact came from social influence—classmates or teaching assistants leading the discussions may have shared their own vegetarianism, showing it as achievable or more common. Second, the video may have had an emotional impact. Least rousing, he thinks, was rational argument, although his co-authors say reason might play a bigger role. Now the researchers are probing the specific effects of teaching style, teaching assistants' eating habits and students' video exposure. Meanwhile, Schwitzgebel—who had predicted no effect—will be eating his words.

questions.stem: Scientists generally believe that the effects of ethics classes are____
questions.explanation: 第 36 题是细节题，正确答案 A）hard to determine. 定位句在第 1 段：尽管伦理课在世界各地都很普遍，科学家们却不确定这些课的内容能否真的改变行为；正反两方面的证据都很薄弱，要么依赖人为设计的实验室测试，要么依赖有时并不可靠的自我报告。正确项与原文构成同义替换（scientists are unsure if their lessons can actually change behavior ↔ hard to determine；evidence either way is weak ↔ hard to determine）。其余三项中，B 项属无中生有、C 项属与原文相反、D 项属答非所问，均可排除。

questions.stem: Which of the following is a reason for the researchers to study meat eating?
options: A) It is common among students.
B) It is a behavior easy to measure.
C) It is important to students' health.
D) It is a hot topic in ethics classes.
questions.explanation: 第 37 题是细节题，正确答案 B）It is a behavior easy to measure. 定位句在第 2 段：据研究合作者、加州大学河滨分校哲学家 Eric Schwitzgebel 介绍，他们选择这种特定行为出于三个原因：学生对该话题的态度可变且不稳定，该行为易于测量，伦理学文献普遍认同少吃肉是好事，因为这能减少对环境的伤害与对动物的痛苦。正确项与原文构成同义替换（behavior is easily measurable ↔ It is a behavior easy to measure）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、C 项属无中生有、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: Eric Schwitzgebel's previous findings suggest that ethics professors____
options: A) are seldom critical of their students.
B) are less sociable than other professors.
C) are not sensitive to political issues.
D) are not necessarily ethically better.
questions.explanation: 第 38 题是细节题，正确答案 D）are not necessarily ethically better. 定位句在第 3 段：Schwitzgebel 此前预测该干预不会产生效果；他先前发现，伦理学教授在投票率、献血和归还图书等一系列行为上与其他教授并无差别。正确项与原文构成同义替换（ethics professors do not differ from other professors on a range of behaviors, including voting rates, blood donation and returning library books ↔ are not necessarily ethically better）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属无中生有、C 项属以偏概全，均可排除。

questions.stem: Nina Strohminger thinks that the effect of the intervention is____
questions.explanation: 第 39 题是态度题，正确答案 C）uncertain. 定位句在第 4 段：未参与该研究的宾夕法尼亚大学心理学家 Nina Strohminger 表示，她希望这种效应是真实的，但不能排除存在某种未知的混杂变量。正确项与原文构成同义替换（she wants the effect to be real but cannot rule out some unknown confounding variable ↔ uncertain；it might be reversible by another nudge ↔ uncertain）。其余三项中，A 项属与原文相反、B 项属无中生有、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

questions.stem: Eric Schwitzgebel suspects that the students' change in behavior____
options: C) is a result of multiple factors.
D) is a sign of self-development.
questions.explanation: 第 40 题是细节题，正确答案 C）is a result of multiple factors. 定位句在第 5 段：Schwitzgebel 猜测最大的影响来自社交影响——主持讨论的同学或助教可能分享了自己的素食习惯，表明这种生活方式是可行的或更普遍的。其次，视频可能产生了情感冲击。他认为最弱的是理性论证，尽管他的合作者认为理性可能扮演更重要的角色。正确项与原文构成同义替换（the greatest impact came from social influence ↔ is a result of multiple factors；Second, the video may have had an emotional impact ↔ is a result of multiple factors；Least rousing, he thinks, was rational argument ↔ is a result of multiple factors）。其余三项中，A 项属无中生有、B 项属答非所问、D 项属无中生有，均可排除。

paragraphs.en: Although ethics classes are common around the world, scientists are unsure if their lessons can actually change behavior; evidence either way is weak, relying on contrived laboratory tests or sometimes unreliable self-reports. But a new study published in Cognition found that, in at least one real-world situation, a single ethics lesson may have had lasting effects.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管伦理课程在世界各地很常见,但科学家们不确定这些课程是否真的能改变行为;无论哪种方向的证据都很薄弱,依赖于人为设计的实验室测试或有时不可靠的自我报告。但发表在《认知》期刊上的一项新研究发现,至少在一种真实世界的情况下,一堂伦理课可能产生了持久的影响。

paragraphs.en: The researchers investigated one class session's impact on eating meat. They chose this particular behavior for three reasons, according to study co-author Eric Schwitzgebel, a philosopher at the University of California, Riverside: students' attitudes on the topic are variable and unstable, behavior is easily measurable, and ethics literature largely agrees that eating less meat is good because it reduces environmental harm and animal suffering. Half of the students in four large philosophy classes read an article on the ethics of factory-farmed meat, optionally watched an 11-minute video on the topic and joined a 50-minute discussion. The other half focused on charitable giving instead. Then, unknown to the students, the researchers studied their anonymized meal-card purchases for that semester—nearly 14,000 receipts for almost 500 students.
paragraphs.zh: 研究人员调查了一堂课对吃肉行为的影响。根据该研究的共同作者、加州大学河滨分校哲学家Eric Schwitzgebel的说法,他们选择这一特定行为有三个原因:学生对该话题的态度是可变且不稳定的,行为易于测量,伦理学文献在很大程度上认同少吃肉是好的,因为它减少了环境危害和动物痛苦。在四个大型哲学课堂中,一半学生阅读了一篇关于工厂化养殖肉类伦理的文章,自愿观看了一个11分钟的相关视频,并参加了50分钟的讨论。另一半则专注于慈善捐赠。然后,在学生不知情的情况下,研究人员研究了他们那个学期的匿名餐卡购买记录——近500名学生的近14000张收据。

paragraphs.en: Schwitzgebel predicted the intervention would have no effect; he had previously found that ethics professors do not differ from other professors on a range of behaviors, including voting rates, blood donation and returning library books. But among student subjects who discussed meat ethics, meal purchases containing meat decreased from 52 to 45 percent—and this effect held steady for the study's duration of several weeks. Purchases from the other group remained at 52 percent.
paragraphs.zh: Schwitzgebel预测这一干预不会产生效果;他此前发现伦理学教授在一系列行为上与其他教授没有差异,包括投票率、献血和归还图书馆书籍。但在讨论了肉类伦理的学生受试者中,含肉的餐食购买从52%下降到45%——而且这一效果在研究持续的几周内保持稳定。另一组的购买则保持在52%。

paragraphs.en: "That's actually a pretty large effect for a pretty small intervention," Schwitzgebel says. Psychologist Nina Strohminger at the University of Pennsylvania, who was not involved in the study, says she wants the effect to be real but cannot rule out some unknown confounding variable. And if real, she notes, it might be reversible by another nudge: "Easy come, easy go."
paragraphs.zh: Schwitzgebel说:"对于一个相当小的干预来说,这实际上是一个相当大的效果。"未参与该研究的宾夕法尼亚大学心理学家Nina Strohminger说,她希望这个效果是真实的,但不能排除某些未知的混淆变量。她指出,如果是真实的,它可能会被另一个推动而逆转:"来得容易,去得也快。"

paragraphs.en: Schwitzgebel suspects the greatest impact came from social influence—classmates or teaching assistants leading the discussions may have shared their own vegetarianism, showing it as achievable or more common. Second, the video may have had an emotional impact. Least rousing, he thinks, was rational argument, although his co-authors say reason might play a bigger role. Now the researchers are probing the specific effects of teaching style, teaching assistants' eating habits and students' video exposure. Meanwhile, Schwitzgebel—who had predicted no effect—will be eating his words.
paragraphs.zh: Schwitzgebel怀疑最大的影响来自社会影响——主持讨论的同学或助教可能分享了他们自己的素食主义,表明这是可实现的或更常见的。其次,视频可能产生了情感影响。他认为,理性论证的激励作用最小,尽管他的共同作者们说理性可能发挥更大的作用。现在研究人员正在探究教学风格、助教的饮食习惯和学生观看视频的具体效果。与此同时,曾预测不会有效果的Schwitzgebel将要食言了。

第 8 空正确答案 C）question。下句把“优先级”解释为要做取舍。其余三项：A）cause 搭配不通、B）purpose 对象错位、D）condition 搭配无该用法，均可排除。
第 9 空正确答案 B）sacrifice。下文细数被让位的活动。其余三项：A）highlight 方向相反、C）continue 方向相反、D）explore 对象错位，均可排除。

第 11 空正确答案 C）while。上句说“听音乐与写作冲突”，本句让步给出例外。其余三项：A）until 时间节点不符、B）because 因果不成立、D）before 时间节点不符，均可排除。

第 13 空正确答案 B）occasional。rather than 后 daily 暗示前空“偶尔”。其余三项：A）intelligent 维度跑偏、C）intensive 方向相反、D）emotional 维度跑偏，均可排除。
第 14 空正确答案 A）habit。social media 的日常行为本质。其余三项：B）test 搭配与语义错、C）decision 搭配错、D）plan 搭配错，均可排除。
第 15 空正确答案 A）tough。won't always make you popular 暗示前句负面。其余三项：B）gentle 色彩相反、C）rapid 维度跑偏、D）funny 色彩相反，均可排除。
第 16 空正确答案 D）in addition to。“除写作外还要保留读书时间”。其余三项：A）in place of 方向相反、B）in charge of 搭配错位、C）in response to 对象错位，均可排除。
第 17 空正确答案 A）indispensable。破折号后“something you can't do without”。其余三项：B）innovative 维度跑偏、C）invisible 形近义错、D）instant 维度跑偏，均可排除。
第 18 空正确答案 D）quicker。常识＋主旨：年纪越大时间越快。其余三项：A）duller 搭配不当、B）harder 对象错位、C）quieter 维度跑偏，均可排除。
